6d39bbba.title: Technical Lead / Solution Architect
6d39bbba.description:
The role
   

  

 You are the person every merge goes through. You own the service contracts that the whole team builds against, you sign the contract freeze, and you command incidents from your first week. In your third week you induct nine engineers who all arrive on the same morning, having yourself been in the building for ten working days.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own the seven API service contracts, draft them by the end of August and sign the freeze with all fifteen seats present
* Approve every merge to main — no exceptions, not for a one\-line fix, not at eleven at night
* Require two\-person review on settlement and payments, with no exception for hot fixes
* Hold review turnaround at 24 hours, and at 6 hours on the money and dispatch paths
* Own the architecture decision log, release and rollback calls, incident triage and post\-incident reviews
* Run the engineering track of the induction week and get all nine joiners to a merged commit by the Friday
* Share the on\-call rota with DevOps — one week on, two weeks off


 Eligibility
   

  

* Eight to ten years in backend engineering, at least three of them leading a team or owning a critical service
* Depth in Java and strong SQL on a Postgres\-class database, plus enough Python to review it
* You have designed and versioned API contracts that other teams built against
* You have run real incidents and written the reviews afterwards
* You have onboarded a group, not just an individual — this seat inducts nine people in its third week


 What you get
   

  

* Seven services and fifteen engineers, from the first line of code
* A daily working relationship with the CTO, and the authority that goes with the seat


 How the process runs
   

  

* Fill in the short form on this page.
* We read it ourselves. Every application is read.
* If we want to meet you, we call you.

a3c11ddc.title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
a3c11ddc.description:
**Company Description**
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, operating, and optimizing cloud platform services. These services must be secure, scalable, and automated. The primary focus is on Microsoft Azure, but the environment spans multiple clouds, including AWS and GCP. You will lead complex technical programs, advances reusable architecture patterns, and strengthen automation and governance practices across assigned platform domains. The Senior Engineer also mentors mid\-level engineers and partners with cross\-functional teams. This ensures that cloud platforms are reliable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards and operational goals. You will report to a Manager.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Design, implement, and improve cloud platform services with a primary focus on Azure, supporting multi\-cloud integrations with AWS and GCP where required.
* Lead complex platform programs across compute, networking, identity, and storage domains, ensuring reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.
* Develop infrastructure\-as\-code solutions using Azure Resource Manager (ARM/Bicep), Terraform, and related frameworks across multiple environments.
* Standardize and improve cloud platform configurations, automation workflows, and deployment pipelines to align with enterprise standards.
* You will improve observability, proactive monitoring, self\-healing capabilities, and incident reduction across platform services.
* You will lead advanced troubleshooting and incident response efforts, conducting structured root cause analysis and implementing long\-term remediation.
* Implement cloud policies, governance controls, and security configurations within Azure and extending equivalent governance and security controls to AWS and GCP.
* Support and guide cloud migration and modernization efforts, including workload onboarding, tenant integration, and hybrid connectivity patterns across Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Collaborate with application, security, networking, and business teams to support cloud adoption, resolve complex issues, and improve platform usability.
* Mentor Level 2 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and operational guidance.


**Summary Of Primary Responsibilities**
* Design reusable infrastructure\-as\-code modules and automation frameworks aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Implement and support Azure\-native services and configurations, including:
+ Virtual Networks (VNets), peering, gateways, and ExpressRoute
+ Hub\-and\-spoke architectures and private endpoint configurations
+ Azure DNS (private zones, resolvers, custom configurations)
+ Azure Entra (identity, role assignments, multi\-tenant configurations, application registrations)
+ Azure Policy (definition, assignment, and enforcement)

* Ensure availability, performance, and reliability of cloud platform services, including compute, storage, networking, and backup capabilities.
* Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and Azure CLI/SDK tooling.
* Improve deployment processes and platform manageability using Azure DevOps and related CI/CD tooling.
* Support integration with enterprise systems, including RESTful services, identity providers, and third\-party vendor solutions.
* Contribute to cost awareness and operational efficiency by supporting resource optimization and understanding Azure billing constructs (subscriptions, billing scopes, enterprise agreements).
* Maintain technical documentation, reference implementations, and operational runbooks.


**Qualifications**
* 5–9 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering within enterprise environments.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure as a primary platform, including deployment, configuration, and operations across enterprise\-scale environments.
* Proficiency in infrastructure\-as\-code using ARM/Bicep, Terraform, or equivalent frameworks, including multi\-environment deployments.
* 5\+ years experience with Azure networking architectures, including VNets, routing, DNS, hybrid connectivity, and distributed system design.
* 3\+ years of experience with Azure identity and access management, including Entra ID, role\-based access control, multi\-tenant configurations, and policy enforcement.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, and cloud provider CLI/SDK tools.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD platforms supporting automated cloud deployments.
* Working knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems in cloud environments.
* Understanding of core networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP) and their application in distributed cloud systems.
* 3\+ years of experience supporting cloud migration initiatives and integrating on\-premises or multi\-tenant environments into Azure.
* Knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity practices, risk management processes, and incident response methodologies.
* You will operate independently, lead complex technical efforts, and influence partners.
* We strongly prefer Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-104, AZ\-305, AZ\-400\); we value AWS/GCP certifications given the multi\-cloud scope of this role.


**Additional Information**
 Our uniqueness is that we truly celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what truly matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, engagement, collaboration, wellness, reward \& recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site to understand why.
   

  

 Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Innovation is a critical part of Experian's DNA and practices, and our diverse workforce drives our success. Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, color, sexuality, physical ability or age. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
   

  

 Experian Careers \- Creating a better tomorrow together
   

  

**Benefits**

 SambaNova Suite™ is the first full\-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on\-premises or in the cloud, combined with state\-of\-the\-art open\-source models that can be easily and securely fine\-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.

 The Cloud Platform team owns the production inferencing service that serves SambaNova's models to customers on RDU accelerators, including capacity planning, deployment, monitoring, and incident response across regions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Cloud Operations team is seeking an experienced engineering leader to scale the platform our internal and external customers use to access SambaNova RDUs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 In this role, you'll architecting our next\-generation system from the ground up, running the Kubernetes infrastructure that powers some of the most advanced AI workloads in the industry, and bridging multi\-cloud and on\-prem environments in ways no generic SaaS company can offer. Your work will directly impact the productivity of every engineer at SambaNova and by extension, the speed at which we ship the future of AI computing.

* Architect, build, and maintain our next\-generation internal developer platform, automating and streamlining our cloud and on\-prem infrastructure
* Design, write, and manage Terraform modules to provision and manage resources across AWS, GCP, and Azure, ensuring consistency and reproducibility
* Build and manage highly available, secure, and performant Kubernetes clusters that serve as the primary runtime for our diverse AI workloads
* Design and implement robust networking solutions (VPCs, load balancers, firewalls, service meshes) that seamlessly connect our multi\-cloud and hybrid environments
* Collaborate with AI and software engineering teams to understand their needs, provide golden paths to production, and build internal tools that accelerate their development cycles
* Implement best practices for observability (monitoring, logging, tracing) to ensure system reliability and performance, and participate in on\-call rotation

a53c32ce.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
a53c32ce.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

d6e14add.description:
**What you will do**


The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end\-to\-end presales engineering activities of Fire and Security opportunities within India from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit\-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno\-Commercial activities of the projects covering various ELV systems such as Fire Alarm System, CCTV Surveillance \& Security System, Access Control System, Public Address System, Parking Management System, Structured Cabling System, network Infrastructure, Building Management Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D\&E and OPS approval for booking

**How you will do it:**

* Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
* Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick\-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
* Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
* Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
* Initiate the discussion with OEMs \& subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
* Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
* Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno\-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
* Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
* Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
* Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet \& assigned training on time.
* Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
* Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
* Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
* Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, Cycle Time, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.

**What we look for**

* BE (Electrical / Electronics / Electronics \& Communication)
* Must have 11\+ years of relevant experience in ELV Systems domains.
* Strong knowledge of ELV \& ICT Systems (Fire Alarm System, CCTV, Access Control, PAVA, Intrusion Detection Systems, Intercom Systems, Gate Barriers, Car parking system, Structured Cabling, Network Switches, etc.).
* Knowledge in Building Management System will be added advantage for the role.
* Must have India projects' presales and estimation experience on various verticals.
* Design know\-how of the ELV \& ICT Systems.
* Capable of understanding ELV Systems specifications and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
* Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
* Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high\-standard technical proposal documents.
* Must have a strong network with the 3rd party vendors in India.
* Must be a quick learner \& keen on problem\-solving techniques.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Must be a good team player.

**Preferred**

* Work experience in all leading access control products (e.g., Software House, Lenel, HID, Suprema, Bosch, Honeywell, etc.)
* Work experience in all leading CCTV products (e.g., American Dynamics, Milestone, Genetec, Pelco, Axis, etc.)
* Knowledge of Fire Alarm Systems products such as Notifier, Simplex, and EST (Edward).
* PAVA, Structured Cabling and Network infrastructure know\-how is a must.
* Knowledge of ACAD, Visio, and Excel.
* Security and fire alarm systems' product certifications will be added advantage.

9da010e2.title: Qentelli Solutions - Technical Product Manager
9da010e2.description:
**Job Summary**
 We're hiring a Technical Product Manager who can hold the platform's integrations and data flows in their head, turn that into a clear product vision, and take it through to a shipped, adopted result. You'll spend real time in the technical weeds, reading integration docs, reasoning about data models, and prototyping ideas yourself before handing them to engineering. You own the roadmap and you own delivery.
   

  

**Technical Skills We're Looking For**
 This is a product role, not an engineering role. You won't be writing production code day to day, but you need to be comfortable enough with code and systems to prototype, pull data, or debug something yourself when it matters.
   

  

**Our stack :** 
 Node.js, TypeScript, Express, and Drizzle on the backend. React, TypeScript, Zustand, and TanStack on the frontend. Postgres for the database, Redis for caching, and JWT for authentication. Event streaming runs across services, with Azure Blob Storage for files. Our AI layer runs on Python, Streamlit, ChromaDB, and RAG.
   

  

* Can read API docs and data models without engineering translating.
* Comfortable reading and reasoning about a TypeScript codebase, front end and back end.
* SQL literacy, comfortable querying Postgres directly to pull and interpret data.
* Understands authentication (JWT), event\-driven architecture, and third\-party integrations.
* Can write or edit a simple TypeScript or Python script for a prototype or data pull.
* Familiarity with RAG pipelines and vector databases (like ChromaDB) is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience with Node.js, React, TypeScript, or Python is a strong plus.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision and roadmap for an AI\-first, agentic operator experience.
* Balance near\-term commitments against longer\-term platform and AI investment.
* Get deep enough into integrations and data flows to make calls without an engineer translating for you.
* Define where AI recommendations or automation remove manual work, and set the guardrails that make it safe.
* Write specs and acceptance criteria engineering can build against the first time, including analytics requirements.
* Run discovery with operators and consumers, and turn findings into prioritized problems.
* Track your initiatives through delivery, flag risk early, and present results to leadership clearly.


**What You Bring**
* 6\-8 years in product management, including 2\+ years owning something with real technical complexity.
* A track record of shipping outcomes you can point to specific metrics for, not just shipping features.
* Experience defining requirements for AI/automation features, including guardrails and failure modes.
* Strong prototyping instincts: comfortable with design tools, no\-code platforms, or AI\-assisted prototyping.
* Sharp communication that flexes between an engineering deep\-dive and a concise executive update.
* Experience designing for time\-constrained, non\-technical, or mobile\-first users.
* A bias toward ownership: you finish what you start and flag problems before they compound.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience in hospitality, travel, marketplace, or commerce platforms.
* Prior experience with loyalty, payments, or booking/reservation systems.
* Experience defining requirements for conversational or voice\-based AI interfaces.


 (ref:hirist.tech)

b071244a.title: AI & Cloud Engineer
b071244a.description:
At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we shape it. Embark on a transformative journey as a Cloud Platform Engineer, where you'll spearhead the delivery of the technology stack, using strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to understand the business requirements and deliver quality solutions coming up with the process design of the Foundational / Consolidated and Business data Products. You will be working on complex technical problems that will involve detailed analytical skills and analysis. This will be done in conjunction with fellow engineers, business analysts, and business stakeholders.
   

  

**To be successful as a AI \& Cloud Engineer, you should have experience with:**
* Proficiency in cloud technologies – Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Openshift.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience with AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face).
* Hands\-on experience with Agent Development Kits (ADK) or similar agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI).
* Proven experience in training and fine\-tuning language models.
* Proficient in IaaS scripting – Terraform / Cloud Formation.
* Ability to use the AWS service APIs, AWS CLI, and SDKs.
* Hands on knowledge of CI/CD process.
* Understanding of parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning methods (LoRA, QLoRA, Adapter layers, Prefix tuning).
* Experience with model quantization, pruning, and optimization techniques.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* A self\-starter with good communication \& and stakeholder management skills.
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval systems.
* Strong understanding and working knowledge of bash scripting and Linux OS.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location of the role is Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber\-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

fc0b8c59.description:
**Company Description** 
 Dev Information Technology Ltd. (DEV IT) is a global technology company listed on NSE and BSE, with nearly three decades of experience delivering innovative IT solutions. As a CMMI Maturity Level 5 organization with ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications, DEV IT focuses on high\-quality, predictable outcomes for clients worldwide. The company leads digital transformation through its ABCD framework: AI, Blockchain, Cybersecurity, and Datacentres \& Infrastructure, supported by strong cloud, application, and managed IT services. DEV IT is a Microsoft Solutions Partner, AWS Advanced Services Partner, and Adobe Partner, working with over 1000 professionals across India and Canada. Headquartered in Ahmedabad, the organization follows a “People First, Business Always” philosophy and offers opportunities to work on cutting\-edge cloud and digital initiatives.
 



  





**Website:** 
**http://www.devitpl.com/**




**Designation: Azure Cloud Architect** 




**Experience: 10\+ years** 




**Location:** 
**Fully remote, open across India.** 




  





**About the role** 




  





**We manage production Azure estates for enterprise customers and we're hiring an architect who can design it and stand behind it when it breaks. This is a hands\-on infrastructure architecture role. You will own how the platform is built, how it is secured, how it recovers, and how much it costs. You will be expected to know the version numbers running in your own environment and to explain the reasoning behind every tool in the stack.** 




  





**What you'll own** 



* **Infrastructure design end to end:** 
 Compute, storage account architecture (tier, redundancy, lifecycle, firewall and private endpoint design), managed disk selection and performance tuning, VNet topology, hybrid connectivity, and Azure Arc for servers and Kubernetes outside Azure.
* **Disaster recovery you have actually tested:** 
 Define RTO/RPO with the business, design the DR topology, build it in Azure Site Recovery and Azure Backup, and run real failover and failback drills. Documented\-but\-never\-executed DR is a failure state here.
* **Automation as the default:** 
 Author and maintain Terraform modules, manage remote state and drift, and build the pipelines that deploy them. Manual portal changes are the exception, and every exception has a reason.
* **AKS in production:** 
 Cluster and node pool design, version lifecycle and upgrade cadence, ingress controller selection and upgrades, networking model, and workload identity.
* **Platform operations at scale:** 
 Azure Lighthouse for delegated multi\-tenant management, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics workspace design, Azure Update Manager, and Azure Backup.
* **Security and cost:** 
 Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID and RBAC, Key Vault, secure score remediation, plus FinOps ownership: cost modelling, right\-sizing, reservations and savings plans, and anomaly investigation.
* **Staying ahead of the platform:** 
 Track Azure Service Health advisories, service retirements, and roadmap changes, and drive the remediation work they trigger before customers feel them.



  





**What we're looking for** 



1. 10\+ years total IT experience with 5\+ years as a Cloud/Infrastructure Architect on Azure.
2. Genuine depth in core IaaS. You can talk through storage redundancy trade\-offs, disk SKU and IOPS decisions, and host caching without reaching for documentation.
3. Terraform written by you, not just reviewed by you. Module authoring, state management, and CI/CD integration.
4. DR design and execution experience — you have personally run a failover, not only planned one.
5. Production AKS operations, including at least one major version upgrade you led.
6. Ability to defend architectural decisions. If your estate uses a third\-party tool for backup, patching, or log management, you can explain precisely what the Azure\-native option could not do.
7. Experience operating multi\-tenant or multi\-subscription estates, ideally with Azure Lighthouse.
8. Direct, structured communication. Our interviews reward a clear answer to the question asked over a broad tour of adjacent topics.



  





**Strongly preferred** 



1. **Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)**
2. **Azure Arc at scale across hybrid or multi\-cloud estates**
3. **FinOps Certified Practitioner**
4. **Regulated\-industry experience (BFSI, healthcare, public sector) with ISO 27001, SOC 2, RBI, or HIPAA controls**



  





**What we offer** 



1. 100% remote across India, \[flexible hours/core overlap]
2. Health insurance
3. Certification sponsorship and paid exam vouchers
4. Performance bonus / ESOPs

e48d9051.title: Principal Backend / Platform Architect — AI SaaS
e48d9051.description:
**About TorQi** 

 TorQi is building a fully managed AI voice platform for the automotive service industry.
 



 Our product is already in production with paying customers and handles real customer conversations, appointment booking, routing, customer intake, and integrations with automotive systems.
 



 We already have a production voice\-AI product.
 



**We are not looking for someone to build another AI voice agent.** 




 Our next engineering priority is strengthening the core platform and backend architecture behind the product.
 



  




**The Mission** 

 We are looking for a senior architect to help us design and evolve
 **TorQi Core** 
 — the platform layer responsible for:
 


* Core business logic
* Multi\-tenant architecture
* Data architecture
* Workflow orchestration
* APIs and webhooks
* Third\-party integrations
* Queues and asynchronous processing
* Reliability and failure recovery
* Observability and monitoring
* Scalability



 Our current platform is already serving production customers.
 



 The challenge is ensuring the architecture can reliably grow from
 **tens of customers to hundreds and eventually thousands of customer locations** 
 without accumulating fragile dependencies, operational bottlenecks, or unnecessary complexity.
 



  




**First Mission: Architecture Audit** 

 We are
 **not looking for someone to immediately rewrite the platform.** 




 Your first engagement will be to understand what exists today and determine what actually needs to change.
 



 You will:
 


* Map the existing architecture and critical workflows
* Review backend and service boundaries
* Evaluate data architecture and multi\-tenancy
* Review APIs, webhooks, queues, retries, and idempotency
* Evaluate workflow/orchestration dependencies
* Identify single points of failure
* Review observability, logging, monitoring, and alerting
* Evaluate third\-party integration architecture
* Identify reliability and scalability risks
* Recommend what to
 **Keep / Improve / Replace**
* Design the target\-state
 **TorQi Core architecture**
* Produce a practical 30/60/90\-day implementation roadmap



  




**A Particularly Important Problem** 

 TorQi integrates with multiple third\-party automotive systems.
 



 We don’t want our core product architecture tightly coupled to any single external provider.
 



 We need an architecture where external systems can be connected, replaced, degraded, or fail without unnecessarily compromising the rest of the TorQi platform.
 



 Experience designing
 **integration abstraction layers, canonical domain models, adapters/connectors, resilient APIs, and failure handling** 
 is highly valuable.
 



  




**What We’re Looking For** 

 Strong experience with:
 


* Production SaaS backend architecture
* Multi\-tenant SaaS platforms
* PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database architecture
* Node.js/TypeScript and/or Python
* Distributed systems
* API and webhook architecture
* Queues and asynchronous processing
* Idempotency and failure recovery
* Integration\-heavy platforms
* Observability and monitoring
* Cloud infrastructure
* High\-availability production systems
* Scaling real production applications



**Bonus, but not required:** 




 Experience with voice AI, telephony, real\-time systems, communications platforms, automotive software, or workflow/orchestration platforms.
 



  




**What We’re NOT Looking For** 

 This is not primarily a:
 


* Prompt engineering role
* RAG/chatbot role
* Frontend role
* LLM integration role
* MVP development role



 We’re looking for someone who has dealt with
 **real production architecture after customers, traffic, integrations, failures, and operational complexity entered the picture.** 




  




**How We Think About Architecture** 

 We don’t want someone who recommends a particular database, cloud provider, microservices, Kubernetes, or a complete rewrite simply because that’s what they know.
 



 We’re looking for someone capable of looking at an existing production system and saying:
 



**“Keep this. Improve this. Move this into the core platform. Don’t touch this yet. This becomes a problem at 10× scale, and here’s why.”** 




**Architectural judgment matters more to us than technology preferences.** 




  




**Potential Long\-Term Opportunity** 

 If the initial architecture audit is successful, this can develop into a longer\-term relationship involving:
 


* Guiding implementation of TorQi Core
* Reviewing critical engineering decisions
* Mentoring backend engineers
* Establishing engineering standards
* Helping recruit additional engineers
* Periodic architecture reviews as TorQi scales



  





**Experience:** 
 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years owning or leading backend/platform architecture for production SaaS systems.
 



 Must have experience designing or scaling real production systems with meaningful customer traffic, multi\-tenancy, third\-party integrations, reliability requirements, and operational complexity.
 



  





**A cover letter is mandatory for this role.** 




**Please send your resume and cover letter to shahriar@torqi.ai** 




**Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.** 




**﻿**




 Please keep it concise and address the following:
 


1. Briefly describe the
 **most relevant production SaaS/platform architecture** 
 you have personally designed or owned. What scale did it reach?

 — work alongside the client's team to design solutions using Trailytics' products; challenge assumptions and bring an outside\-in point of view.

 — ensure our products become embedded in the client's daily decision\-making, through onboarding, training, and consistent business reviews.

 — translate client needs into clear requirements for our product and engineering teams, and translate our capabilities back into business language.

 — track value delivered, build the ROI narrative, and identify opportunities to deepen and expand the engagement.

**Experience \& domain**

 **eCommerce and/or supply chain**

 **embedded, consultative, co\-creation work** 
 — you've designed solutions
 *with* 
 clients or business teams, not just delivered against a brief.



**Ways of working** 



* Credible with senior stakeholders — you hold the room with GM/Head\-level leaders and are taken seriously as a peer.

601a4bc3.title: Specialist Software Architect
601a4bc3.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
   

  

**So, What's the Role All About?**
 We are looking for a
 **Specialist Software Architect** 
 to lead the architectural vision, design, and evolution of our AI\-driven and Conversational Solutions platform. This role demands deep hands\-on expertise in
 **Python** 
 ,
 **AWS Cloud services** 
 ,
 **AWS Knowledge Hub** 
 , and
 **multiple Knowledge Base technologies** 
 , along with proven experience designing simplified, scalable, and resilient architectures using
 **microservices** 
 and
 **AWS\-native services** 
 .
   

  

 You will play a critical role in shaping the technical foundation of our Conversational AI platform — one that handles millions of interactions per day, meets strict SLAs (99\.99%), and supports zero\-downtime deployments, robust disaster recovery, and enterprise\-grade AI orchestration. You will be the go\-to architect for proposing pragmatic, simplified designs that balance innovation with operational excellence.
   

  

**How Will You Make an Impact?**
**Architecture \& System Design:**
* Own and define the end\-to\-end architecture of the Conversational AI and Knowledge platform, covering AI model integration layers, data stores, knowledge bases, and external integrations.
* Design enterprise\-scale, cloud\-native, microservices\-based architectures capable of handling high concurrency, burst traffic, and real\-time conversational workloads.
* Propose simplified, cost\-effective architectural designs leveraging AWS\-native services — avoiding over\-engineering while ensuring scalability and resilience.
* Define reference architectures, architectural blueprints, and non\-functional requirements (NFRs) for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Drive event\-driven and asynchronous architectures using AWS\-native services such as SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and Step Functions.
* Define best practices for microservices design, domain\-driven design (DDD), API design (REST, async/event APIs), and AI integration patterns.
* Review and guide complex application\-level designs, critical code paths, and AI pipeline architectures.


**AI \& Conversational Solution Architecture:**
* Architect and evolve AI\-driven Conversational solutions integrating large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering patterns, and enterprise AI orchestration frameworks.
* Design and implement Knowledge Base solutions using AWS Knowledge Hub, vector databases, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures, and other knowledge management technologies.
* Define AI model integration strategies — including model selection, fine\-tuning approaches, embedding pipelines, and response quality frameworks.
* Drive conversational UX architecture, ensuring seamless, context\-aware, and low\-latency interaction flows.
* Evaluate and recommend AI tooling, platforms, and frameworks aligned with business needs (e.g., AWS Bedrock, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, Kore.ai, Dialogflow).
* Lead the design of multi\-turn conversation management, intent resolution, and fallback handling architectures.


**AWS Cloud \& Microservices Architecture:**
* Architect and optimise solutions using AWS services including but not limited to Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Aurora Serverless, S3, Bedrock, and Kendra.
* Design cost\-efficient, elastic scaling strategies aligned with unpredictable conversational AI workloads.
* Lead cloud governance, environment isolation, multi\-account strategy, and infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) practices.
* Define CI/CD pipeline standards, DevOps practices, and containerisation approaches (Docker, Kubernetes) for AI workload deployments.
* Drive microservices decomposition strategies — identifying service boundaries, inter\-service communication patterns, and data ownership models.


**Scalability, Resilience \& Disaster Recovery:**
* Design for extreme scale — high concurrent users, high TPS, and real\-time AI inferencing demands.
* Own resilience strategies including multi\-AZ and multi\-region architectures, active\-active or active\-passive DR setups, and graceful degradation mechanisms.
* Define and validate RPO/RTO goals, conduct chaos testing, and lead DR drills.
* Ensure zero\-downtime deployment capabilities through blue/green, canary, and rolling deployment strategies.


**Security, Compliance \& Reliability:**
* Embed security by design across all AI and data architecture layers — covering authentication, authorisation, data privacy, encryption, and model safety guardrails.
* Support compliance requirements (SOC2, ISO, GDPR) from an architectural standpoint, particularly around AI data handling and knowledge base access controls.
* Partner with SRE and DevOps teams on observability, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting for AI workloads.
* Define SLIs, SLOs, and capacity planning models for conversational AI services.


**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration:**
* Act as a technical mentor and trusted advisor to senior engineers, tech leads, and implementation teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, design councils, and technical decision forums — championing simplicity, pragmatism, and long\-term maintainability.
* Partner closely with Product Management, AI/ML teams, and delivery teams to balance innovation with execution feasibility.
* Drive the long\-term AI architecture roadmap and proactively reduce technical debt.


**Have You Got What It Takes?**
**Experience \& Education:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 4–5 years in a software architect or principal engineer role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering AI\-driven or Conversational AI platforms at enterprise scale.


**Technical Expertise:**
* Deep hands\-on experience with Python — including AI/ML libraries, API development, and automation scripting.
* Strong expertise in AWS Cloud services — particularly those relevant to AI workloads: Bedrock, Kendra, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, and Aurora Serverless.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS Knowledge Hub and multiple Knowledge Base technologies including vector databases, document stores, and semantic search platforms.
* Proven experience designing microservices architectures — including service decomposition, inter\-service communication (REST, gRPC, event\-driven), and distributed data management.
* Strong understanding of:
+ RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures and embedding pipelines
+ Prompt engineering and LLM integration patterns
+ Modern authentication standards (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML)
+ Web APIs — REST and async/event API design
+ Databases (SQL/NoSQL) and data integration patterns

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with AI tooling and platforms such as AWS Bedrock, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, Dialogflow, or Kore.ai.
* Experience with GenAI and Agentic AI application development.


**Architecture \& Scale:**
* Demonstrated success designing systems for high traffic, low latency, and high availability at global scale.
* Deep experience with resilience, disaster recovery, and failover design in cloud\-native environments.
* Strong track record of proposing simplified, pragmatic architectural solutions that avoid unnecessary complexity.
* Experience with event\-driven systems, message queues, and streaming architectures.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, caching strategies, and data modelling for AI workloads.


**Good to Have:**
* Experience with CCaaS or real\-time communication platforms (e.g., NICE CXone).
* Exposure to multi\-region SaaS deployments and hybrid serverless/container architectures.
* Familiarity with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch for conversational data search and analytics.
* Experience with cost optimisation strategies at scale on AWS.
* Knowledge of frontend technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, React) for full\-stack architecture awareness.


**What's in It for You?**
 Join an ever\-growing, market\-disrupting, global company where the teams — comprised of the best of the best — work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment. As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
   

  

**Enjoy NiCE\-FLEX!** 
 At NICE, we work according to the NiCE\-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility — 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work each week. Office days focus on face\-to\-face collaboration where teamwork and creative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 10787
   

  

**Reporting Into:** 
 Director , Engineering
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contributor
   

  

**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

7aa17f81.title: Lead  Infrastructure and Cloud Architect
7aa17f81.description:
* We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
* Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
* Enjoy a varied \& challenging role.


**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
   

  

 Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
   

  

 We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data\-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior IT Architect with Worley***
 , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* To lead the design and evolution of Worley’s global infrastructure and cloud platforms, ensuring they are scalable, resilient, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles. Security, compliance, and operational integrity are seamlessly embedded throughout the architecture lifecycle to enable secure innovation and reliable global delivery.


**Infrastructure and Cloud Architecture**
* Design and optimize hybrid and multi\-cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, OCI) to support global enterprise workloads, including high\-performance and resilient AI workloads.
* Define and standardize architectural patterns for compute, storage, networking, and platform services that enable efficient AI model training, inference, and data processing.
* Drive adoption of Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), automation, and GitOps frameworks for consistent, repeatable deployments and operations.
* Embed security and compliance controls into infrastructure designs, including identity management, encryption, segmentation, and policy enforcement.
* Ensure observability, monitoring, and resilience are integral to all platform architectures.
* Collaborate with data and AI platform teams to ensure alignment between infrastructure, data pipelines, and MLOps environments.


**Embedded Security and Resilience**
* Partner with enterprise and security architects to align infrastructure designs with global security standards and regulatory frameworks.
* Support threat modeling, risk assessments, and architecture assurance reviews for infrastructure and AI deployments.
* Apply resilience\-by\-design principles, incorporating redundancy, failover, and recovery mechanisms across cloud and on\-prem environments.
* Champion a culture of secure\-by\-default and continuous improvement in infrastructure and cloud operations.


**Architecture Governance and Standards**
* Contribute to the definition, evolution, and enforcement of global infrastructure and cloud standards, including AI and data\-specific requirements.
* Ensure architectural decisions are documented, traceable, and compliant with enterprise governance frameworks.
* Participate in architecture review boards and provide expert guidance to delivery and engineering teams.
* Establish lifecycle governance to ensure infrastructure architectures remain aligned with evolving business, regulatory, and technology needs.


**Collaboration and Enablement**
* Collaborate with application, data, and security architects to design and deliver integrated, secure, and scalable infrastructure solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering and operations teams, fostering a culture of architectural excellence and innovation.
* Engage with business and technology stakeholders to translate strategic goals into actionable, measurable infrastructure capabilities.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration and knowledge sharing to accelerate the adoption of modern cloud, AI, and automation practices.


**Skills And Experience**
* 16\+ years in infrastructure and cloud architecture roles within large\-scale, complex enterprise environments.
* Deep experience with multi\-cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, OCI), hybrid networking, and infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, GitOps).
* Proficiency in container orchestration (Kubernetes, AKS/EKS/OKE) and infrastructure observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* Familiarity with embedded security practices — IAM, encryption, secure connectivity, and compliance automation.
* Working knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) and cloud reference architectures.
* Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure, GPU/accelerator environments, and MLOps pipelines is highly desirable.
* Understanding of FinOps principles for cost optimization and governance in multi\-cloud environments.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Azure or AWS Solutions Architect (Professional Level)
* TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification
* ITIL or COBIT for operational alignment
* CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or HashiCorp Terraform Associate
* Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, ISO 27001\) are advantageous


**Key Attributes**
* Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long\-term vision and pragmatic delivery.
* Strong communicator who can translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
* Collaborative leader who builds trust across teams and drives architectural alignment.
* Curious and adaptable, with a passion for innovation in cloud, automation, and AI infrastructure.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
   

  

 Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.
   

  

 Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

e7b6899d.title: Presales Presentation and Qualification Specialist
e7b6899d.description:
**METAGUISE** 




 Pre\-Sales Presentation \& Qualification Specialist
 



***Gurgaon, Haryana, India /Full\-time\-Monday\-Saturday / Timings\-2pm\-11pm***




 About Metaguise
 



 Metaguise designs and manufactures architectural metal cladding and facade systems for landmark commercial, institutional and residential projects. Our work spans parametric metal facades, perforated and welded modules, and premium interior cladding — specified by leading architects across India, the Middle East and Europe.
 



 Role Summary
 



 You are the first voice a prospective client hears. You will present Metaguise’s credentials, capabilities and case studies to architects, developers, PMCs and contractors over Zoom and Microsoft Teams — then run a structured discovery conversation to capture the design intent, scale, timeline and commercial context of their project. You will log this into our CRM and hand a qualified, well\-documented brief to the sales team.
 



 This is not a cold\-calling role. Leads are inbound and inbound\-referred. Your job is to represent the brand with polish and extract the intelligence that lets our sales team win.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Deliver Metaguise’s credentials presentation and curated case studies to international and Indian clients over video calls
* Conduct structured discovery: design language sought, project scale and area, material and finish preferences, budget band, timeline, decision\-making structure and competitive set
* Qualify opportunities against defined criteria and prioritise accordingly
* Maintain complete, accurate CRM records — call notes, briefs, attachments, next actions and pipeline stage
* Prepare and deliver clean handover briefs to the sales and technical teams, including full project diligence
* Coordinate follow\-up scheduling and keep prospects warm until sales engagement begins
* Maintain and improve the presentation deck and case study library in coordination with marketing
* Track and report on lead quality, call\-to\-qualified\-opportunity conversion, and market\-wise trends



 Requirements
 



**Essential** 



* 2–5 years in pre\-sales, client\-facing presentation, inside sales, business development or account management
* Exceptional spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent — you will present daily to GCC, European and Indian audiences
* Strong on\-camera presence: confident, composed and articulate across a structured 30–45 minute presentation
* Demonstrated CRM proficiency (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Pipedrive or similar) with genuine discipline in data hygiene
* Excellent active listening and note\-taking; able to translate a loose client conversation into a precise written brief
* Fluent with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace and PowerPoint



**Preferred** 



* Exposure to architecture, construction, building materials, interiors or facade systems
* Experience working with Middle East or European clients
* Ability to grasp technical vocabulary quickly — finishes, substrates, fabrication methods, installation systems
* Additional language: Arabic, French or German



 What Success Looks Like
 


* Within 30 days: fluent, independent delivery of the Metaguise credentials presentation
* Within 60 days: running discovery calls solo with complete CRM capture
* Within 90 days: measurably improved brief quality and reduced sales\-team rework on handovers



 What We Offer
 


* Competitive salary with performance\-linked incentive tied to qualified pipeline
* Direct exposure to landmark international architecture projects
* Structured training on Metaguise products, processes and technical vocabulary
* Growth path into key account management or market ownership



 To Apply
 



 Send your CV and a 2–3 minute video introduction to \[email] describing a project or product you admire and why. We assess communication ability directly — a strong video matters more to us than a long CV.
 



*Metaguise is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on capability alone.*

61f9dd96.description:
**ZS** 
 is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
 **bringing together data, science, technology** 
 and
 **human ingenuity** 
 to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side\-by\-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life\-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
 **client\-first mentality** 
 to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life\-changing impact to ZS.
   

  

 We are seeking a seasoned Salesforce professional with a deep understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, particularly in the field of Salesforce Health Cloud. This individual will play a crucial role in expanding our Salesforce practice, driving digital transformation across various industries, with a special focus on healthcare. Our firm looks to leverage your innovative thinking and leadership to develop cutting\-edge business solutions that leverage AI and Analytics to deliver maximum value to our clients.
   

  

 The candidate will be part of our Salesforce Expertise practice. As a Salesforce expert, the candidate will draw on their skills and experience to lead defining salesforce related business solutions/sales plays; work with team(s) to develop ZS capabilities (including: selling collateral and assets/accelerators/demos); and take the offerings to ZS’ client to convert to real opportunities, supporting the entire lifecycle of engagements. To do so, you will need to deeply understand customer requirements, understand the salesforce.com ecosystem and work closely with functional specialists to develop innovative, cutting\-edge business solutions leveraging AI/Analytics to maximize the value to our clients. You will work closely with functional specialists to develop creative business solutions, solving some of the most exciting problems for our clients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* End\-to\-End Delivery Management:
+ Deliver exceptional client service, ensuring projects stay within expected timeframes and budgets.
+ Review application and technical design documents, ensuring they follow Salesforce best practices and integrate effectively into the client's infrastructure.
+ Team and Capability Development:
+ Develop team skills and collaborate to create accelerators and assets that enhance our service offerings to clients.

* Offerings and Business Development:
+ Collaborate with ZS and industry experts to define integrated programs and offerings, taking them to market with the client service teams.
+ Lead large\-scale business development and delivery engagements, especially in the Healthcare sector.

* Mentoring and Coaching:
+ Provide on\-the\-job feedback and coaching to team members and actively participate in the counseling and mentoring of junior consultants within the organization.

* Solution Architecture and Design:
+ Collaborate with healthcare organizations to understand their business needs and design customized Salesforce Health Cloud solutions.
+ Lead the architecture and design of scalable, secure, and high\-performance Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

* Technical Guidance and Quality Assurance:
+ Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, data models, and integration patterns.
+ Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices are followed for Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree with major in Computers or Electronics.
* 10\+ years’ of overall professional experience; with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a professional services firm.
* Proven experience as a Salesforce Health Cloud Architect, designing and implementing solutions for healthcare organizations.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, including platform configuration, Visual Force, Lightning, Workflows, Apex, and AppExchange.
* In\-depth knowledge of healthcare data models and HIPAA regulations.
* Proficiency in shaping, providing consulting, building \& implementing solutions using Salesforce cloud offerings.
* Good understanding of DevOps as they apply to Salesforce, including various methodologies and tools such as Salesforce DX.
* Active Salesforce Certifications Architect is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel to meet client needs.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect.
* Proficiency in using MuleSoft and familiarity with other Salesforce cloud offerings like Sales, Service, Community, and Marketing Cloud.
* Working experience with Salesforce.com organization to leverage the ecosystem.
* The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of motivation, excellent problem\-solving skills, a strong work ethic, and executive\-level presence and communication.


**How you’ll grow:**
* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s\-curves, individual contribution and role expansions


**Perks \& Benefits:**
 At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations \| Where we work \| ZS.
   

  

**Hybrid working model:**
 We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on\-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face\-to\-face connections.
   

  

**Travel:**
 Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client\-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

 At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here.
