In addition to supporting larger and more complex programs, you will also have the opportunity to independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, taking ownership of planning, execution, stakeholder communication, and successful delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Coordination**
* Support the successful delivery of software, cloud, data, AI, and application development projects.
* Coordinate sprint execution, release planning, project tracking, and delivery milestones.
* Assist Delivery Managers in monitoring project health, risks, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Track project progress, team capacity, resource allocation, and delivery metrics.
* Escalate delivery risks and blockers proactively while driving timely resolution.
* Ensure project documentation, governance artifacts, and status reports are maintained accurately.
* Support multiple concurrent Agile projects and distributed engineering teams.
* Independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, owning end\-to\-end delivery including planning, execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful project outcomes.
* Balance responsibilities across independently managed engagements while providing delivery support to larger, strategic programs led by senior Delivery Managers.


**Agile Delivery \& Scrum Leadership**
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives.
* Coach Scrum teams on Agile principles, Scrum values, and continuous improvement practices.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy product backlogs and sprint priorities.
* Track sprint progress, velocity, burndown charts, and release readiness.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks and work with teams to remove impediments.
* Foster accountability, collaboration, transparency, and ownership across Agile teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on retrospective outcomes and delivery metrics.


**Project Governance \& Reporting**
* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and delivery metrics for stakeholders.
* Monitor sprint health, schedule adherence, defect leakage, resource utilization, and delivery milestones.
* Maintain project plans, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and action trackers.
* Ensure compliance with delivery governance standards and organizational processes.
* Support forecasting activities, release planning, and sprint commitments.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and customer teams.
* Communicate project status, delivery progress, risks, and mitigation plans effectively.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities to ensure alignment between business and engineering teams.
* Support customer meetings, sprint demos, governance reviews, and project updates.
* Serve as the primary Delivery Manager and customer point of contact for smaller engagements, ensuring effective stakeholder communication, governance, and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain a customer\-first mindset throughout project execution.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Promote Agile best practices across delivery teams.
* Encourage knowledge sharing, collaboration, and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, predictability, and team productivity.
* Contribute to organizational Agile maturity initiatives.
* Support Delivery Managers in implementing operational excellence initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Project Coordinator, Associate Project Manager, Delivery Coordinator, or similar role, with demonstrated ability or readiness to independently manage smaller customer engagements.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, Kanban, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing sprint execution.
* Hands\-on experience working with cross\-functional software engineering teams.
* Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of Agile metrics including Sprint Velocity, Burndown Charts, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Defect Leakage, Resource Utilization, Schedule Adherence, and Delivery Milestones.
* Experience coordinating multiple workstreams within Agile projects.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in fast\-paced, collaborative environments.
* Exposure to cloud technologies (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure) is preferred.
* Exposure to AI, Data, Analytics, or Application Development projects is an added advantage.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* Experience working in consulting, professional services, or customer\-facing organizations.
* Exposure to cloud migration, AI/ML, data modernization, analytics, or digital transformation projects.
* Experience supporting distributed or global engineering teams.
* Familiarity with delivery governance, release management, and Agile reporting.
* Experience independently managing small to mid\-sized customer engagements or end\-to\-end project delivery is preferred.
* Passion for coaching Agile teams and driving continuous improvement.

0b2d1381.title: Salesforce Technical Architect (FINS/Auto/MFG/Retail Industry)
0b2d1381.description:
**Description**
 Salesforce Professional Services India partners with enterprise customers to design, implement, and scale transformative Salesforce solutions. With deep platform expertise and a strong focus on business outcomes, we work with some of India's most complex and strategic organisations — making a real global impact from one of Salesforce's highest\-priority growth markets.
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with deep specialization in Financial Services (FINS), Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG), Automotive, OR Manufacturing sectors, alongside mastery of the Salesforce ecosystem and AI\-first engineering practices.
   

  

 In this role, you won't just be designing systems; you will be a Trusted Advisor, guiding our premier enterprise clients through complex, AI\-driven digital transformations. You will bridge the gap between ambitious business goals and robust technical execution, maintaining a "Full Stack Mindset" that covers everything from high\-level discovery to hands\-on deployment.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Architectural Leadership: Lead the end\-to\-end design and architecture of complex, multi\-cloud Salesforce solutions specifically tailored for FINS, RCG, Automotive, or Manufacturing challenges.
* Enterprise AI Architecture: Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits.
* Architectural Simulation \& Design: Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases.
* Cross\-Cloud Innovation: While rooted in Salesforce, you will explore and integrate solutions across Industry Clouds (Financial Services Cloud, Consumer Goods Cloud, Automotive Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, or Revenue Cloud) and third\-party ecosystems to ensure the business receives the most efficient solution.
* Discovery to Go\-Live: Own the technical and functional scope throughout the project lifecycle. This includes leading discovery workshops, defining data governance and guardrails, and ensuring a smooth transition to Go\-Live.
* Team Orchestration: Provide technical governance and mentorship to large, diverse teams of developers and testers, ensuring code quality, security models, and architectural integrity.
* Hands\-on Excellence: While your focus is strategic, you are willing and able to "get into the weeds" to solve high\-complexity technical hurdles or build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) when required.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Domain \& Technical Expertise**
* Multi\-Domain Specialist: Extensive experience navigating at least one key industry landscape—Financial Services (FINS), Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG), Automotive, OR Manufacturing.
* Salesforce \& Industry Cloud Mastery: Proven track record in Salesforce architecture, with a focus on Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Consumer Goods Cloud, Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or Revenue Cloud (CPQ \& Billing), alongside Sales/Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* AI\-First Delivery Methodology: Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects.
* Complex Engagements: Experience leading at least 3\+ large\-scale, complex Salesforce implementations for global enterprise brands across target industries.
* Full\-Stack Mindset: Comfort working across the entire stack—from UI/UX considerations and Apex/LWC development to complex integrations (MuleSoft/REST/SOAP) and data architecture.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
**Domain \& Industry Expertise**
* 12\+ years in IT with at least 3\+ years specifically in Financial Services, Retail/Consumer Goods, Manufacturing, OR Automotive domains.
* Proven track record of delivering at least 2–3 large\-scale, complex engagements for global enterprise brands.
* Deep understanding of industry\-specific flows in at least one of the following areas:
+ Financial Services (FINS): Wealth Management \& Client Onboarding, Commercial/Retail Banking, Insurance Policy \& Claims Lifecycle, Household/Relationship Mapping, and Regulatory Compliance (KYC/AML/FINRA).
+ RCG: Route\-to\-market, Retail Execution, Trade Promotion Management (TPM), Scheme Management, and B2B/B2C Commerce.
+ Manufacturing \& Auto: Sales Agreements, Account Forecasting, Vehicle/Asset Lifecycle Management, Partner/Dealer Portals, and Lead Management.
+ Revenue Management: CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), Subscription Management, Billing, Contract Lifecycle, and Order Management.


**Technical Prowess**
* Salesforce Mastery: Extensive experience with Apex, LWC, Integrations (REST/SOAP/Middleware), Salesforce Shield, and Industry Data Models (OmniStudio / Industry Cloud Architecture).
* Architecture Frameworks: Strong knowledge of TOGAF or similar frameworks; expertise in designing for high\-volume data and complex security models.
* Certifications: Application/System Architect certifications and at least 6 domain badges. Financial Services Cloud Accredited Professional, Agentforce/AI certifications, CPQ Specialist, Revenue Cloud AP, or Industry Cloud certifications are highly preferred.

You'll be the technical voice in the room before a deal is signed, sitting with prospective customers to understand what they actually need, and translating our products (XgenPlus, ZenithAI, RajMail, TeamPortal and more) into a solution that fits. You'll work closely with engineering to scope what's realistic, and with sales to close what's valuable. You'll be led by a founder who personally architected the core protocol stack (IMAP, SMTP, POP, anti\-spam) this company still runs on, and who chairs the global body writing the standards for a multilingual internet. If you want your name on production systems that matter, not another CRUD app for another client, this is where that happens.

41f008af.title: Senior AI Solution Engineer
41f008af.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
 Join Novonesis as a Senior AI Solution Engineer and help accelerate the development and adoption of AI solutions across our global organisation. You will train and support citizen developers, advise business teams, and help ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards. The role combines enablement, consulting, and hands\-on problem solving in a collaborative, highly adaptive, and cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 \*\*Welcome to the Data \& AI Enablement team\*\*
   

  

 The Data \& AI Enablement team is part of the Data Office within Global IT, serving as a Centre of Excellence for enterprise\-wide data and AI adoption. You will join a highly collaborative team of specialists in Denmark and India, working closely with business stakeholders in an agile and supportive environment.
   

  

 Together, we help citizen developers and business teams create value from platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Copilot, and Copilot Studio through enablement, governance, and community building. The role offers broad exposure across Novonesis, connecting you with stakeholders and initiatives spanning the entire value chain.
   

  

 \*\*In this role you will make an impact…\*\*
   

  

 You will focus on execution and scaling enablement activities, strengthening the team’s capability within generative AI and the technology stack, including Copilot Studio. By working closely with principal roles and senior stakeholders, you will deliver hands\-on support and guidance, helping citizen developers build effective solutions. Your contribution will drive adoption, foster community engagement, and support business teams in refining and implementing Copilot Studio solutions, ensuring successful self\-service AI development across Novonesis.
   

  

 In addition, some of your key tasks will include:
   

  

* Delivering training sessions, onboarding, and workshops for Copilot Studio
* Creating learning materials and supporting documentation
* Guiding users in building solutions and troubleshooting use cases
* Driving adoption through AI cafés, demos, and community forums
* Ensuring solutions follow defined standards and contributing to knowledge sharing


 Collaboration will be central to your role, as you work daily with colleagues in India and Denmark, engaging with stakeholders across business\- and platform teams to deliver impactful AI solutions.
   

  

 \*\*We expect you to bring…\*\*
   

  

* 2–4 years of experience in AI, automation, or digital enablement roles
* Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or similar citizen developer platform
* Experience with project management
* Experience working with generative AI or conversational agents
* Interest in AI adoption and enabling others


 Additionally, we expect you to be familiar with Microsoft Ecosystem including Copilot/Cowork, Power BI and Fabric, experience supporting training and user enablement, and a basic understanding of AI/ML concepts. Your ability to support complex solution design and align technical solutions with business requirements will be highly valued.
   

  

 You will be expected to demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills, a solution\-oriented approach, eagerness to learn and work with emerging technologies, and the ability to structure and handle multiple tasks. A focus on service and helping others succeed is essential to this role.
   

  

**Our purpose guides the way**
 In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**Opportunities for everyone**
 We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
   

  

 We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
   

  

**Explore Other Openings**
 If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

**Why N\-able**
 At N\-able, we’re not just helping businesses be secure —we’re redefining what it means to be cyber resilient. Our end\-to\-end platform blends AI\-powered capabilities and flexible tech stacks, so customers can manage, secure, and recover with confidence. But the real power behind it all? Our people. We’re a global crew of N\-ablites, who love solving complex problems, sharing knowledge, and delivering solutions that actually make a difference. If you're into meaningful work, fast growth, and a team that’s got your back, you’ll be surrounded by people who believe in what they do—and in you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 A seasoned, experienced technical professional with a complete understanding of software architecture. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. As an Architect, responsible for design and implementation of micro\-services architecture based product focusing on SIEM/SOAR platforms, building threat detection solutions, and optimizing workflows for faster threat resolution and better SOC efficiency.
   

  

* Design and implement microservices\-based architectures
* Lead solutioning for cloud\-based applications, primarily using AWS (EC2, RDS, EKS, S3, etc.).
* Develop and validate POCs to demonstrate architecture viability.
* Automating repetitive SOC tasks to reduce analyst workload and improve Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).
* Identifies and works on challenging problems; understands and applies business models within the architecture function.
* Building and maintaining SOAR playbooks for tasks like alert enrichment, incident triage, automated containment, and ticketing.
* Understand the pros and cons of various approaches to software architecture; develop prototypes to evaluate the feasibility of technical solutions.
* Transforms user and non\-functional requirements into a technical design that is scalable, reliable, performant, and secure; formulates unique solutions to complex problems.
* Demonstrates independent judgment when determining solutions; identifies and addresses the root cause of issues.
* Evaluate alternative solutions using research data; drive problem resolution from definition to successful completion; Demonstrate proactivity and focus on "getting things done"; provide regular feedback and help engineers grow.
* Provides mentoring to engineers and assists less\-experienced peers in prioritizing projects and tasks.
* Presents ideas to technical and business audiences.
* Evangelizes the technical vision with the development team, product managers, and program managers


**What You'll Bring**
* Deep understanding of a runtime platform like python or GoLang/Java/C\+\+
* Proficiency in Docker, Kubernetes, and Linux environments
* AWS (EC2, RDS, EKS, S3, etc.)
* Demonstrated proficiency in multiple areas of programming (e.g., web development, concurrency, non\-blocking I/O, algorithms, etc.)
* Very good knowledge of commercial software design and development practices
* Highly skilled in the following areas: Coding, Software Design, Testing, Test Automation, and Product Design
* Ability to positively impact business and technical outcomes
* Marked interest in exploring and utilizing new technologies
* Familiarity with cloud\-native platforms and architectures
* Demonstrated mastery of one or more programming languages
* Familiarity with CI/CD best practices
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies
* A Bachelor's, Master’s, or Ph.D. and 15\+ years of related experience; or equivalent work experience


**Purple Perks**
* Group Medical , Personal Accident \& Term life coverage
* Generous PTO and observed holidays
* 2 Paid VoluNteer Days per year
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* FuN\-raising opportunities as part of our giving program
* N\-ablite Learning – custom learning experience as part of our investment in you
* The Way We Work – our hybrid working model based on trust and flexibility


**About N\-able**
 At N\-able, our mission is to protect businesses against evolving cyberthreats with an end\-to\-end cyber resilience platform to manage, secure, and recover. Our scalable technology infrastructure includes AI\-powered capabilities, market\-leading third\-party integrations, and the flexibility to employ technologies of choice—to transform workflows and deliver critical security outcomes. Our partner\-first approach combines our products with experts, training, and peer\-led events that empower our customers to be secure, resilient, and successful.

54b5432f.title: Senior Solutions Architect - Generative AI
54b5432f.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect who can operate fluently across two worlds: the AI Factory infrastructure stack\-designing accelerated compute environments built on DGX/HGX, networking, storage, and orchestration \-and the Generative \& Agentic AI application stack \-guiding customers through open\-source frameworks, NeMo, NIM, and Blueprints to deliver production AI workloads.
   

  

 You will be a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, partnering with sales, product, and engineering to translate business outcomes into deployable architectures.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead enterprise customers through the full lifecycle of on\-prem Generative AI — from use case discovery and model selection to fine\-tuning, deployment, and continuous evaluation.
* Architect production\-grade RAG systems using NeMo Retriever, embedding and reranker NIMs, and vector databases such as Milvus, pgvector, and Weaviate, tuned for accuracy, latency, and cost at scale.
* Guide customers in selecting and customizing open\-source foundation models like Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and Gemma, and lead them through fine\-tuning workflows using NeMo Customizer, PEFT/LoRA, SFT, DPO, and RLHF.
* Compose and build agentic applications using frameworks like LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and NVIDIA AI Blueprints, covering use cases such as customer service automation, enterprise search, document intelligence, video analytics, software engineering agents, and industry\-specific copilots.
* Advise on inference optimization with TensorRT\-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang, including quantization, speculative decoding, and multi\-LoRA serving.
* Champion responsible AI practices: guardrails (NeMo Guardrails), red\-teaming, evaluation harnesses, and observability for LLM and agent systems.
* Help customers operationalize GenAI with accurate MLOps — versioning, CI/CD for prompts and models, drift detection, and human\-in\-the\-loop feedback.
* Provide architectural mentorship on on\-prem AI Factory deployments built around DGX BasePOD/SuperPOD, HGX\-based OEM systems, Spectrum\-X and Quantum InfiniBand networking, and high\-performance storage.
* Scale clusters appropriately for combined fine\-tuning and inference tasks. Build orchestration layers through Kubernetes, including the NVIDIA GPU Operator, Network Operator, and Run:ai. Apply Slurm as needed.
* Lead technical workshops, PoCs, and architecture reviews with enterprise customers as well as represent NVIDIA at customer briefings, industry events, and technical forums.
* Translate field findings into product feedback for NVIDIA engineering as well as build reusable assets such as reference architectures, deployment guides, and demos that scale across the SA community.


**What We Need To See**
* 5–8 years of experience as a Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, ML Platform Engineer, or similar customer\-facing technical role.
* Strong hands\-on background with accelerated computing infrastructure: GPUs, high\-speed interconnects (InfiniBand, RoCE), parallel file systems (Lustre, GPFS, WEKA, VAST, or DDN or equivalent experience), and data center fundamentals.
* Production experience with Kubernetes and at least one workload scheduler like Run:ai, Slurm, KubeFlow, or Volcano in GPU\-accelerated environments.
* Practical depth in Generative AI: LLM training/fine\-tuning, RAG architectures, inference optimization (TensorRT\-LLM, vLLM, SGLang), and quantization.
* Experience with the NVIDIA AI Enterprise software stack (NeMo, NIM, Triton, RAPIDS, CUDA\-X) or a strong desire and capability to learn rapidly.
* Experience crafting solutions for enterprise constraints: air\-gapped environments, data sovereignty, security/compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP\-adjacent), and multi\-tenancy.
* Excellent communication skills \- able to present to CTOs and CIOs, then drop into a kubectl session with a platform engineer.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex agents) in production settings.
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or published technical content (blogs, talks, papers).
* Experience working with NVIDIA AI Blueprints or developing equivalent enterprise reference solutions.
* Background in a specific vertical \- financial services, healthcare/life sciences, manufacturing, retail, or telco.
* Familiarity with sovereign AI initiatives or large\-scale on\-prem GenAI deployments. Working knowledge of MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, Argo, Kubeflow Pipelines).


 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

93711001.title: Architect - SAP S4 Migration - Asset & PS Specialist
93711001.description:
**Overview**
 The SAP S4 Migration is a comprehensive, multi\-year program spanning over four years, aimed at modernizing the current SAP PIRT landscape. This initiative covers various regions including MENA, LATAM, PGCS, APAC, and Europe. The goal of this program is to prepare the SAP system for the future, aligning it with PepsiCo's digital transformation journey.
   

  

 The project involves planning, executing, and overseeing the successful migration of data and business processes from existing SAP ECC systems to S/4HANA. This will include designing remediation of deprecated functionalities, designing new functionalities for obsolete functionalities, executing data migration objects, and ensuring data quality and integrity throughout the process. This will also be working in close collaboration with technical and business stakeholders to align goals and expectations.
   

  

 The project aims to replace legacy systems by implementing the SAP S/4 HANA business suite. This suite will cover various functions including Record to Report (RTR), Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), Order to Cash (OTC), Purchase to Pay (PTP), Make to Deploy (MTD), Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Warehouse Management (WM) and Trade Promotional Management (TPM).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ensure Seamless Migration: Ensure that SAP ECC processes are remediated and migrated to SAP S/4 RTR out any design gaps focussing on G/L, Banking, Assets, Project Systems etc.
* Design and Build: Create design documentation where existing functionalities have become obsolete. Remediate object which are identified by for remediation.
* System Readiness: Prepare the current SAP system for migration by applying necessary updates and configurations, such as SAP notes and pre\-migration checks.
* Data Migration: Oversee the technical migration of data from legacy systems to the SAP S/4HANA environment. Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance throughout the migration process by conducting data validation and reconciliation
* Data Validation: ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
* Comprehensive Testing: Conduct thorough testing to validate the functionality and performance of the new system, ensuring it meets all business requirements and standards.
* Change Management: Support the Change management in identifies processes and/or transactions which will get impacted.
* Training and Support: Provide training and support to super users for the changes to ensure a smooth transition and effective use of the new system.
* Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve data migration issues promptly, collaborating with data migration and tech team as needed. Track issues throughout the migration life cycle and ensure issue resolution in timely manner for the overall project success
* Promote Collaboration: Foster an environment where communication, teamwork, and innovation are encouraged.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure adherence to the internal IT operating model, including technology standards, project life cycle methodology, release management, change management, and other related processes and procedures, SLAs, and controls compliance. Accountable for ensuring proper governance is followed for all RTR areas
* Project Communication: Own project status and communication for all related work in the project. Accountable for ensuring project status reporting is done weekly and senior executive\-level communications are timely and accurate.
* Reuse Asset: Create reuse asset which can be leveraged during migration to optimize the efforts for sectors planned later in the migration journey.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum bachelor’s degree is required. Computer Science or Information Systems is preferred.

0afa5921.title: Global Technology Solution Owner – Consolidation & Reporting
0afa5921.description:
**Job Summary**
 The Global Technology Solution Owner \- Consolidation \& Reporting acts as the primary Business Partner for Finance functions in Consolidation, Product Margin Calculation, Reporting, and Analytics. In this role, you will serve as the IT functional lead, collaborating closely with Business Teams, Technology Teams, and Business Process Owners (BPO) to drive functional and process\-related discussions.
   

  

 You will hold active governance and technical ownership of solutions in the Consolidation \& Reporting area (e.g., SAP Finance Reporting \& Analytics Core governance), working alongside Business and Technical Delivery Teams to shape, prioritize, and realize technology evolution. Developing and defining the technology direction, strategy, and roadmap for Finance Consolidation and Product Margin solutions aligned with the overall SAP Finance Reporting \& Analytics strategy and in cooperation with relevant Platform and Architecture Teams\-is a key component of this role.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Define, align (with Business leads and within Technology teams) and support building technology delivery strategy for Finance consolidation, product margin calculation, reporting and analytics solutions with an aim of bringing cutting\-edge innovation, process standardization with high focus on user experience, automation and efficiency improvements.
* Ensure on time, within budget and quality delivery of portfolio in a compliant manner in line with Business expectations and Technology strategy
* Continuously improve the solutions to meet the ongoing business requirements and optimize the costs to have an improved TCO
* Own the design of innovative, fit\-for\-purpose, reusable and scalable assets in C\&R business area and steer deployment with delivery teams following Business priorities to generate the desired Business outcome
* Run the established governance structure for projects with right stakeholder representation in area of responsibility. Support overall establishment of corresponding governance structures in SAP Finance \& Analytics team
* Track, report and deliver against agreed success factors and KPIs for various stakeholders in Technology and Finance Business
* Provide transparent and accurate project/program/portfolio management and reporting. Own program/project status, issues and risks in area of responsibility. Manage risks and issues through appropriate channels / tools with focus on setting and tracking actions, ownership, and comprehensive risk management.
* Collaborate and Ensure operational services / enhancements are effectively delivered in the area of responsibility
* Collaborate effectively with other teams, Technology Functions and Domains in the organization, as well as strategic suppliers providing services.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* 10\+ years of experience in program/project delivery and application portfolio management within SAP BI space (e.g. BW/BI/BPC, SAC, BDC, BW/4HANA) with special focus on Finance, in multinational organizations.
* Strong technical skills in SAP BW/BI/BPC, SAC and ideally in BDC, BW/4HANA, Datasphere, Databricks
* Proven experience in Group wide financial consolidation processes, product margin calculation, and reporting \& analytics
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audience
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong leadership, people management experience and team\-building skills.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and drive change and innovation.
* Experience in managing global SAP related projects and working in diverse cultural environments.
* Proficiency in using advanced software tools and platforms relevant to the job.
* Experience with ITIL frameworks and other service management methodologies.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Business Administration, or related field; (Master’s degree is preferred) or adequate/comparable alternative education/documented experience
* Certification in SAP BI and analytics area (e.g. SAC, BDC, BW/4HANA, BI/BPC, etc.) or proven/documented expertise in SAP BI/Analytics area
* Education/certification/proven expertise in Financial and Management accounting and/or Financial Consolidation beneficial
* Experience with Agile/DevOps methodologies; Certification is a plus.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**

**Meet Our Team**
 The Enablement and Effectiveness (E\&E) team is an organization of highly collaborative individuals who are passionate about training and enablement. As an ATP Program Manager, you will own and scale Pega's Authorized Training Partner program by managing partner relationships, governance, and training\-demand handoffs.
   

  

**Picture Yourself At Pega**
 Working with clients, partners and internal sales and consulting resources, you’ll play a critical part in extending Pega’s global training reach while maintaining quality, consistency, and alignment with Pega Academy standards while you support the strategic growth of our Authorized Training Partner ecosystem.
   

  

 At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
   

  

 We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
   

  

**What You'll Do At Pega**
 The Pega Authorized Training Partner (ATP) Program Manager is responsible for the overall success, scalability, and governance of Pega’s global Authorized Training Partner ecosystem. This role owns partner relationships, promotes the ATP program internally and externally, and defines and operationalizes the end‑to‑end hand‑off of training demand from Pega to Authorized Training Partners.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 The Pega Authorized Training Partner (ATP) Program Manager is responsible for the overall success, scalability, and governance of Pega’s global Authorized Training Partner ecosystem. This role owns partner relationships, promotes the ATP program internally and externally, and defines and operationalizes the end‑to‑end hand‑off of training demand from Pega to Authorized Training Partners.
   

  

* You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
* You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


**What You've Accomplished**
* You have experience working in a technical training environment in a sales or leadership role
* You’ve collaborated with sales, consulting and/or customer success teams to position training as part of an enterprise software sale
* You have worked with 3 rd party organizations to deliver training services to common clients
* You have prepared and delivered presentations outlining training offerings, process and deliverables


**Pega Offers You**
* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products
* Continuous learning and development opportunities
* An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment
* Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay \+ bonus incentive, employee equity in the company
* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices.

50bc5412.title: Principal AI Solution Engineer
50bc5412.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
 Join Novonesis as a Principal AI Solution Engineer and play a leading role in scaling AI solutions across our global organisation. You will drive enterprise\-wide enablement, support the development of AI use cases, and help translate business opportunities into solutions. You will provide strategic guidance and help build the capabilities needed to accelerate AI adoption at scale in a highly adaptive, and cross\-functional environment. \*
   

  

 \*\*Welcome to the Data \& AI Enablement team. \*\*
   

  

 The Data \& AI Enablement team is part of the Data Office within Global IT, serving as a Centre of Excellence for enterprise\-wide data and AI adoption. You will join a highly collaborative team of specialists in Denmark and India, working closely with business stakeholders in an agile and supportive environment. Together, we help citizen developers and business teams create value from platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Copilot, and Copilot Studio through enablement, governance, and community building. The role offers broad exposure across Novonesis, connecting you with stakeholders and initiatives spanning the entire value chain.
   

  

 \*\*In this role you will make an impact…\*\*
   

  

 Your work will focus on innovation and enablement at scale, balancing strategic platform governance with hands\-on solutioning. You will help mature our enablement model for Copilot Studio, establish best practices for citizen developers, and guide business teams from ideation to implementation. Through our AI Centre of Excellence approach, you will support complex use cases and act as a senior advisor, identifying AI use cases and opportunities for AI to transform business processes.
   

  

 In addition, some of your key tasks will include:
   

  

* Owning the Copilot Studio enablement track globally, including training, governance, and support.
* Establishing best practices for citizen developers working with Copilot Studio.
* Driving enterprise adoption of Copilot\-based solutions by engaging with business teams and shaping high\-value use cases.
* Building and scaling the citizen developer ecosystem through training programmes, learning journeys, and community activities.
* Ensuring governance, security, and platform and use case alignment by collaborating with IT Security, Legal, and platform teams.


 Collaboration will be central to your role, as you work daily with colleagues in India and Denmark, engaging with stakeholders across business\- and platform teams to deliver impactful AI solutions.
   

  

 \*\*We expect you to bring…\*\*
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in AI, automation, or digital enablement roles
* Strong experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or similar citizen developer platform
* Proven track record of driving adoption of new technologies in large organisations
* Proven track record for project management
* Experience working with generative AI or conversational agents
* Experience with governance frameworks within enterprise environments


 Additionally, we expect you to demonstrate familiarity with Microsoft Ecosystem including Copilot/Cowork, analytics platforms such as Power BI and Fabric, and a background in consulting or internal advisory roles. Your ability to support complex solution design and align technical solutions with business requirements will be highly valued.
   

  

 You will excel in this role if you have strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills, enjoy structured and scalable thinking, and are comfortable navigating an evolving space. An interest in AI adoption and its organisational impact, as well as the ability to bridge business needs and technical solutions, will help you succeed.
   

  

**Our purpose guides the way**
 In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**Opportunities for everyone**
 We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
   

  

 We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
   

  

**Explore Other Openings**
 If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

cdfdbe44.title: Senior Cloud and DevOps Engineer
cdfdbe44.description:
**Job Description**
 Cloud / DevOps Engineer would lead the implementation, automation, and operational reliability of cloud\-native and DevOps solutions across Azure environments, with awareness of equivalent AWS patterns where required. The role would involve transformation of MVP applications into production\-grade, multi\-tenant SaaS platforms by enabling cloud\-native deployment architecture—driving database migration support, containerized deployments on Azure, secure identity and access management, CI/CD pipeline implementation, observability setup, environment consistency, and performance optimization for scalable operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Cloud Architecture \& Implementation**
* Design and implement scalable, secure, and cost\-optimized cloud solutions primarily on Azure.
* Drive adoption of PaaS, managed services, and container\-based deployment models.
* Enable deployment architecture using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and Entra ID / AAD.
* Establish cloud governance, environment consistency, access control, and cost optimization practices.


**Containerization \& Platform Engineering**
* Design and implement container\-based application deployment using Docker.
* Build and optimize Docker Compose setups for multi\-service environments and multi\-stage builds for secure, lightweight images.
* Support deployment using orchestration services such as Kubernetes (AKS / EKS awareness) or Azure Container Apps.
* Improve platform consistency, portability, and deployment repeatability.


**CI/CD \& DevOps Transformation**
* Architect and implement end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps.
* Enable automated builds, testing, and deployment with multi\-stage environment promotion.
* Support deployment strategies such as blue\-green, canary, or rolling updates.
* Improve release reliability, deployment speed, and operational maturity.


**Reliability, Observability \& Operations**
* Implement observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, and APM tooling.
* Enable health checks, readiness validation, alerting, incident response readiness, and SLO\-based monitoring.
* Support resilience mechanisms including retries, graceful degradation, and fault\-aware deployment patterns.


**Security \& DevSecOps**
* Implement secure DevOps practices including secret management, identity and role\-based access controls, and pipeline\-integrated security scans.
* Ensure secure configuration and alignment with enterprise standards for cloud delivery and operations.


**Performance \& Scalability**
* Support performance strategies including caching, autoscaling, deployment tuning, and environment optimization.
* Assist with provisioning and managing Redis / distributed cache services where applicable.
* Enable scalable deployment patterns for growing user demand and system load.
* Required Technical Skills
* Docker / Containers \| Advanced — Compose, multi\-stage builds, image hardening, container deployment
* Azure Cloud \| Proficient — App Service, Functions, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID / AAD
* CI/CD \| Advanced — GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps; automated testing and staged deployments
* Git \| Advanced — branching strategies, PR workflows, repository governance
* Cluster Provisioning \& Management \| Proficient — Kubernetes / AKS / container orchestration awareness
* Monitoring \& Operations \| Proficient — Azure Monitor, App Insights, dashboards, alerts, logs
* Security \& Automation \| Proficient — secrets, identity, access control, scanning, IaC awareness


**Required Experience**
* Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Cloud / DevOps engineering.
* Proven experience in enabling cloud\-native deployment practices for enterprise or SaaS applications.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and environment promotion strategies.
* Experience supporting containerized deployments and modern cloud\-hosted applications.
* Experience with observability, operational monitoring, and incident\-supporting platform practices.
* Exposure to secure DevOps practices, secrets management, and identity\-based access controls.
* Experience improving deployment reliability, automation, and operational consistency across environments.


**Preferred (Not Required)**
* Exposure to MVP\-to\-production modernization programs.
* Experience with Terraform / Bicep / infrastructure\-as\-code tooling.
* Exposure to SaaS multi\-tenancy, API gateways, or cloud platform hardening.
* Experience in consultancy, infrastructure, or engineering sector platforms.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted engineering productivity tooling.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or platform operations.

6719e9c1.title: Lead Architect - Azure & Agentic AI Solutions
6719e9c1.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
   

  

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Lead Architect \- Azure \& Agentic AI Solutions**
*Architecture leadership for Azure deployment, agent design, orchestration and end\-to\-end solution flow*
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Lead Architect to define the target architecture for an enterprise\-grade procurement agentic AI solution. The role will determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, establish architecture principles and guardrails, and advise on agent architecture, orchestration patterns, integration design, and end\-to\-end solution flows. The Lead Architect will work closely with client technology stakeholders, the Solution Lead, AI/ML teams, data engineers, security teams and delivery leadership to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, operable and fit for enterprise deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end target architecture across data, AI/ML, GenAI, agent orchestration, APIs, integration, observability, security and user\-facing application layers.
* Assess client constraints and determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, including services for compute, storage, data processing, model serving, GenAI, integration, secrets, networking, monitoring and CI/CD.
* Define cloud deployment patterns across Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks or equivalent data platforms, AKS, Container Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus or Event Grid, Key Vault, Monitor and related services as appropriate.
* Advise on when to use agents, conventional services, rules engines, workflow orchestration, ML models, optimization services and event\-driven automation rather than forcing all use cases into an agent pattern.
* Translate business workflows into executable solution flows spanning sensing, signal processing, forecasting, recommendation, approval, action and traceability layers.
* Define API and integration architecture for interaction with enterprise source systems, planning tools, data platforms, UI applications, model endpoints and external services.
* Establish non\-functional requirements and architecture guardrails for scalability, latency, resilience, disaster recovery, cost efficiency, explainability, auditability and supportability.
* Define identity and access patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, data protection controls, content safety, prompt security and responsible AI controls in collaboration with client security teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical decision records and trade\-off discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide hands\-on guidance to engineering teams on implementation patterns, reusable components, deployment standards and technical issue resolution.
* Own architecture alignment across environments including development, test, UAT, and production, with clear promotion, rollback and release patterns.
* Guide observability design across application traces, agent traces, prompt and tool execution, model performance, API metrics, data pipeline health, cost usage and business process outcomes.
* Support capacity planning and cloud cost optimization, including workload sizing, token consumption controls, autoscaling, caching, batching and appropriate service selection.
* Collaborate with the Lead Manager and Solution Lead to balance delivery timelines with architecture quality and enterprise readiness.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution architecture, cloud architecture, platform engineering or related technology leadership roles.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise deployment patterns.
* Proven experience designing distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, containerized workloads and cloud\-native integrations.
* Strong understanding of GenAI and agentic AI architecture, including LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, state and memory patterns, evaluation, guardrails and human approval mechanisms.
* Ability to design architectures that combine conventional software services, AI/ML models, optimization engines, data pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Strong knowledge of security, identity, networking, observability, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code and production operations in enterprise environments.
* Experience engaging with client architects, CIO/CTO organizations, cloud platform teams, security stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Strong ability to communicate architecture trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders and drive decisions under real\-world constraints.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, AKS, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault, Entra ID and Azure Monitor.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent patterns and frameworks.
* Exposure to supply chain, demand forecasting, planning, semiconductor or high\-tech industry solutions.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, prompt and agent evaluation and production AI governance.
* Relevant Azure architecture certifications or equivalent demonstrable experience.


**Key Deliverables**
* Target\-state solution architecture and Azure service deployment blueprint.
* Agent architecture and orchestration design, including tool boundaries and control flows.
* End\-to\-end sequence flows for key business scenarios and exception paths.
* Integration, API, identity, networking, security, observability and environment architecture.
* Architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, deployment standards and engineering guardrails.
* Production\-readiness and scalability recommendations, including cost and operational considerations.


**Key Success Metrics**
* Architecture is accepted by client technology and security stakeholders with minimal late\-stage redesign.
* Solution is deployable, scalable, secure, observable and supportable across enterprise environments.
* Agent and orchestration patterns remain controlled, explainable and appropriate to the business workflow.
* Reduction in integration rework, deployment friction, technical debt and avoidable cloud cost.
* Engineering teams can implement consistently using clear architecture standards and reusable patterns.


 If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
   

  

 Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
 *Introduce Yourself* 
 in the top\-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

b5d22ae1.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
   

  

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Lead Architect – Full\-Stack, Cloud, Data \& AI Engineering**
*Technical leadership of the end\-to\-end build, with accountability for establishing the team's deployment capability and mentoring Forward Deployed Engineers to independence*
**Role Overview**
 The Lead Architect sets and owns the technical direction for enterprise agentic AI solutions across application, cloud, data and AI layers — and delivers it through the team rather than personally. The primary mandate is to raise engineering capability: establish standards and reusable deployment assets, guide design and review work, and mentor Forward Deployed Engineers until they can build, deploy and operate solutions in client environments without escalation. Hands\-on work is expected selectively — to stay technically credible and unblock the team — not as sustained feature delivery.
   

  

**Capability Coverage**
**Full\-stack engineering**
**What the role is accountable for \-** 
 Standards and patterns for Python services, JavaScript/TypeScript front ends, SQL and NoSQL data design, APIs, CI/CD and DevOps
   

  

**Mode of working \-** 
 Guide, review, spike
   

  

**Azure cloud architecture**
**What the role is accountable for \-** 
 Target\-state architecture, service selection, identity, networking, environments, non\-functional targets and cloud cost discipline
   

  

**Mode of working \-** 
 Own and decide
   

  

**Data engineering**

 PySpark and Databricks pipeline architecture, layered data design, quality controls and performance standards
   

  

**Mode of working \-** 
 Direct and review
   

  

**AI engineering \& AIOps**
**What the role is accountable for \-** 
 Agent and orchestration design, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, human\-approval flows, tracing, versioning and drift monitoring
   

  

**Mode of working \-** 
 Own and direct
   

  

**Leadership Responsibilities**
* Technical direction: Own the target architecture and the agentic\-versus\-deterministic decisions; hold the line on where agents add value and where rules or workflows suffice.
* Lead through the team: Break scope into buildable increments, run design walkthroughs and code reviews, and set the coding, testing, release and documentation standards the team works to.
* Build deployment capability: Convert today's person\-dependent deployment into documented, reusable practice — reference architecture, IaC modules, pipeline templates, runbooks and environment checklists.
* Mentor FDEs to independence: Pair on builds, review their designs, run structured enablement, and hand over deployment ownership against defined competency milestones.
* Stakeholder ownership: Carry architecture and security posture through client technology and security review; act as final technical escalation on deployment and production issues.
* Selective hands\-on: Prototype high\-risk components, resolve critical\-path blockers, and review production code — sufficient depth to make credible decisions, without becoming the delivery bottleneck.


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years in software, platform or applied AI engineering, including 4\+ years leading engineering teams on systems that reached production.
* Full\-stack delivery background — Python, relational and NoSQL stores, web application deployment, CI/CD and DevOps practice.
* Hands\-on architecture experience with the standing to own and defend decisions with client cloud and security teams.
* Working depth in PySpark and Databricks, and in agent development with a mainstream orchestration framework plus evaluation and production monitoring.
* Demonstrated record of mentoring engineers and raising team capability — not only shipping personally.


**Success Measures**
* Named FDEs deploy and operate solutions independently; delivery is not dependent on this individual.
* Time\-to\-deploy reduces engagement over engagement through reusable assets and standards.
* Solutions reach production on committed timelines, with architecture and security accepted with minimal remediation.
* Agent quality, availability, latency and cloud cost tracked against defined baselines, with regressions caught pre\-release.

5cb59c62.title: Senior Cloud Developer
5cb59c62.description:
CHEP helps move more goods to more people, in more places than any other organization on earth via our 347 million pallets, crates and containers. We employ approximately 13,000 people and operate in 60 countries. Through our pioneering and sustainable share\-and\-reuse business model, the world’s biggest brands trust us to help them transport their goods more efficiently, safely and with less environmental impact.
   

  

 What does that mean for you? You’ll join an international organization big enough to take you anywhere, and small enough to get you there sooner. You’ll help change how goods get to market and contribute to global sustainability. You’ll be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and be surrounded by diverse and driven professionals. And you can maximize your work\-life balance and flexibility through our Hybrid Work Model.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Senior Cloud Developer, you will act as a core engine for our cloud platform, designing and implementing highly scalable, resilient, and secure AWS infrastructure. You will champion automation by driving GitOps patterns, managing Kubernetes environments, and embedding deep observability into our ecosystem. Additionally, you will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure and data platforms, designing reliable data streaming pipelines and optimization frameworks to support high\-throughput data engineering workloads.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities May Include**
* Design, engineer, and implement robust security solutions to protect cloud infrastructure, containerized applications, and data, ensuring alignment with best practices.
* Collaborate with software engineering teams to configure and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient CI/CD pipelines, incorporating security controls throughout the development lifecycle.
* Build and maintain customized integrations and dashboards for proactive threat monitoring, intrusion detection, and vulnerability scanning, ensuring timely responses to security incidents.
* Perform regular security audits, threat modelling, vulnerability scanning, and penetration testing, automating these processes wherever possible to detect and respond to potential breaches.
* Advise on risk mitigation strategies, providing recommendations to enhance security posture and addressing identified vulnerabilities across cloud environments.
* Collaborate with system administrators, network engineers, and developers to implement security best practices, including access controls, encryption, logging, and monitoring across cloud platforms.
* Configure and document security policies, access management protocols, and vulnerability management processes to ensure compliance and governance standards are met.
* Develop and implement incident response plans, ensuring quick and effective action in the event of a security breach or vulnerability exploit.


**Senior Cloud Developer, Bangalore**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Automate Infrastructure: Design and maintain infrastructure using Terraform via GitOps continuous delivery workflows.
* Manage Containerization: Architect, scale, and optimize production\-ready Kubernetes (EKS) clusters.
* Embed Observability: Implement comprehensive monitoring, tracing, and logging frameworks across all cloud services.
* Build Data Pipelines: Architect and maintain event\-driven streaming and ETL pipelines for high\-volume data engineering jobs.
* Develop Cloud Tooling: Write clean, maintainable backend code in Python, Go to build internal tools and data utilities.
* Optimize Performance: Monitor system health, debug complex distributed data systems, and continuously improve cloud reliability and costs.


**Technical Skills**
* Cloud Platform: Advanced expertise in AWS core services (IAM, VPC, EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda).
* Orchestration \& IaC: Deep operational knowledge of Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Data \& Streaming Stack: Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka, and Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms.
* Observability Stack: Strong experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel), Prometheus, and the Grafana stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir).
* Programming Languages: Professional proficiency in both Python or Golang.


**Functional \& Domain Expertise**
* Data Engineering \& ETL: Deep understanding of designing, building, and optimizing batch and real\-time ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Event\-Driven Architecture: Mastery of data streaming, message queuing, pub/sub patterns, and handling real\-time data sync via CDC.
* Cloud\-Native Architecture: Strong understanding of microservices design, 12\-factor app methodologies, and serverless patterns.
* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): Solid grasp of distributed tracing, metrics aggregation, error budgeting, and building self\-healing systems.


**Experience Requirements**
* Total Experience: 6\+ years of professional software engineering, DevOps, or data infrastructure experience.
* Cloud \& Container Focus: 3\+ years of dedicated experience managing AWS environments and production Kubernetes workloads.
* Data Pipeline Delivery: Proven track record of implementing Kafka clusters, configuring CDC solutions, and managing relational data layers like PostgreSQL.
* Observability Implementation: Demonstrated success setting up OpenTelemetry pipelines and building advanced Grafana dashboard ecosystems.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks for unified data analytics and processing.
* Official certifications such as AWS Certified Data Engineer, AWS DevOps Engineer, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
* Experience with service meshes (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) and GitOps controllers (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux).


**Why Join This Team?**
 You will join a forward\-thinking, highly collaborative engineering team that genuinely values modern engineering principles over legacy processes. We bridge the gap between bleeding\-edge cloud infrastructure and high\-throughput data platforms, bypassing manual processes in favor of true GitOps automation. You will have the autonomy to solve complex distributed systems puzzles, build event\-driven architectures, and make a massive impact on the data velocity and operational reliability of our entire organization.
   

  

**Remote Type**
 Hybrid Remote
   

  

**Skills To Succeed In The Role**
 Adaptability, Adaptability, Agile Methodology, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Automation Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Security, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery Methodologies, Data Analysis, Disaster recovery and high availability, Docker (Software), Empathy, Experimentation, GitHub, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Lambda, Linux, NoSQL, Prometheus, Python (Programming Language), Scala (Programming Language), Spark, Structured Query Language (SQL), Systems Programming {\+ 5 more}
   

  

**We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to developing a diverse workforce in which everyone is treated fairly, with respect, and has the opportunity to contribute to business success while realizing his or her potential. This means harnessing the unique skills and experience that each individual brings and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class.**
**Individuals fraudulently misrepresenting themselves as Brambles or CHEP representatives have scheduled interviews and offered fraudulent employment opportunities with the intent to commit identity theft or solicit money. Brambles and CHEP never conduct interviews via online chat or request money as a term of employment. If you have a question as to the legitimacy of an interview or job offer, please contact us at recruitment@brambles.com.**

91f188dc.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
91f188dc.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE** 
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web\-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Flexible and positive approach to work with willingness to travel based on business requirements.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prior experience in software product pre\-sales, solution consulting, business consulting, or client\-facing product demonstrations.
* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, fintech organizations, or enterprise software companies is preferred

**Company Description** 
 Vayuterra Capital is a dynamic real estate advisory and investment firm focused on creating smarter, more rewarding property investment opportunities for individuals, investors, businesses, and channel partners. The firm specializes in real estate investment advisory, primary and secondary market transactions, commercial real estate, and tailored property investment solutions. Combining market intelligence, strong developer and channel partner relationships, and a deep understanding of investor needs, Vayuterra Capital helps clients make informed and confident real estate decisions.
