b6cecb92.title: Algoworks - Atlassian Solution Architect
b6cecb92.description:
**About The Company**
 Algoworks is an award\-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India.
   

  

 We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable results.
   

  

 For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 Our work combines human\-centered design, engineering excellence and AI\-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision.
   

  

 Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem\-solving and continuous improvement.
   

  

 At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact.
   

  

 Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise.
   

  

 The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.
   

  

 Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Algoworks is seeking a world\-class, experienced and highly hands\-on Atlassian Solution Architect to lead the architecture, governance, optimization and evolution of our Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Jira Service Management, Tempo and related capabilities.
   

  

 This role is responsible for ensuring the Atlassian platform operates as a scalable enterprise system rather than a collection of individual projects, workflows and configurations.
   

  

 The architect will combine deep Atlassian expertise with strong systems thinking and business understanding to design simple, secure, maintainable solutions that improve delivery, governance, productivity and data quality.
   

  

 The successful candidate must be proactive and naturally curious about platform health.
   

  

 This person should continuously inspect the environment, identify control gaps, configuration sprawl, technical debt, security risks, inefficient workflows and data\-quality issues and independently drive scalable remediation rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.
   

  

 The architect will set the technical direction, platform standards and solution patterns within which administrators and business teams operate, while remaining hands\-on enough to prototype, troubleshoot and validate complex solutions personally.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Atlassian architecture and strategy :
* Define and continuously evolve the enterprise architecture and roadmap for Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Tempo and related Atlassian capabilities.
* Design scalable standards for projects, workflows, issue types, schemes, fields, screens, permissions, roles, automation, applications and integrations.
* Establish reusable configuration patterns that reduce unnecessary customization, simplify administration and prevent technical debt.
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, scalability, security, maintainability and cost.
* Platform governance, health and continuous optimization :
* Continuously assess the Atlassian environment for architectural weaknesses, configuration sprawl, redundant fields and workflows, excessive permissions, control gaps and performance risks.
* Identify root causes behind recurring platform issues and replace workarounds or manual fixes with sustainable system\-level solutions.
* Establish governance for access, configuration changes, applications, automation and platform standards, with appropriate testing, deployment and rollback controls.
* Maintain clear architecture documentation, configuration standards and technical decision records so the platform remains governable as the organization scales.
* Business process and solution design :
* Partner with Delivery, PMO, Finance, HR, Sales, IT and leadership to understand business processes and translate them into effective Atlassian solutions.
* Analyze the underlying business problem before recommending configuration, automation, customization or integration and challenge approaches that create unnecessary complexity.
* Design solutions that balance user experience, governance, reporting, automation and long\-term maintainability.
* Measure the effectiveness of major platform changes through clear improvements in productivity, control, data quality, visibility or business outcomes.
* Automation, AI and extensibility :
* Proactively identify repetitive, manual or error\-prone processes that can be automated within or around the Atlassian ecosystem.
* Design scalable Jira and Tempo automation with appropriate validation, exception handling, monitoring and awareness of platform limits.
* Use APIs, scripting, cloud services or custom extensions when native capabilities are insufficient, while avoiding unnecessary custom development.
* Evaluate and implement AI\-enabled capabilities that improve project management, reporting, support, knowledge management and administrative productivity.
* Enterprise integration, data and reporting :
* Architect reliable integrations between Atlassian and enterprise platforms such as CRM, ERP, HCM, identity, Microsoft/Azure and business intelligence systems.
* Define system\-of\-record responsibilities, data models, mappings, APIs, authentication, synchronization rules, reconciliation and error\-handling controls.
* Ensure Jira and Tempo are structured to produce accurate, consistent and decision\-ready data without excessive manual transformation.
* Partner with analytics teams to enable automated operational and executive reporting and resolve data\-quality issues at their source.
* Technical leadership and platform enablement :
* Provide architectural direction and technical guidance to Jira Administrators and other teams working within the Atlassian ecosystem.
* Review significant changes for architectural impact, scalability, security and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Lead solution design, technical assessments, proofs of concept and major platform enhancements from concept through implementation.
* Develop team capability so recurring administration can be executed independently within clear architectural and governance standards.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience across Atlassian platforms, enterprise applications or solution architecture, with significant hands\-on Jira experience.
* Deep expertise in Jira Cloud, Jira Service Management, Confluence and the broader Atlassian ecosystem.
* Strong experience with Tempo and enterprise time, resource, capacity or delivery\-management use cases.
* Expert understanding of Jira workflows, schemes, issue types, custom fields, screens, roles, permissions, automation and application architecture.
* Proven experience designing and simplifying enterprise\-scale Atlassian environments.
* Strong experience with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, scripting and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Atlassian with CRM, ERP, HCM, identity, cloud and analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, access governance, SSO, user provisioning and auditability.
* Proven ability to proactively identify architectural weaknesses and independently design scalable remediation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across systems, data, integrations and business processes.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into simple, maintainable technical solutions and communicate clearly with engineers and senior business stakeholders.


**Must Have Skills**
* Jira Cloud, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Tempo \- enterprise architecture and administration.
* Strong expertise in Jira workflows, schemes, permissions, custom fields, automation and governance.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, scripting and enterprise integrations.
* Strong Atlassian solution architecture, security, scalability and technical\-debt management experience.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with Atlassian integrations with Azure, CRM, ERP, HCM and BI platforms.
* Knowledge of SSO, identity management, access governance and audit controls.
* Experience with AI\-enabled automation and Atlassian extensibility.


**Desired Attributes**
* Deeply curious about how systems work, where they fail and how they can be improved.
* Proactively identifies problems instead of waiting for tickets, incidents or instructions.
* Thinks in enterprise architecture rather than isolated Jira configurations.
* Strong instinct for simplifying complexity and eliminating technical debt.
* Hands\-on enough to prototype, troubleshoot and validate solutions personally.
* Comfortable challenging existing approaches and proposing better alternatives.
* Makes decisions based on scalability, maintainability, security and measurable business value.
* Rigorous, analytical and detail\-oriented with strong follow\-through.
* AI\-savvy and continuously explores better ways to automate work.
* Strong communicator and collaborative partner across technical and business teams.
* Fun, engaging personality and a team player.


**Interview Process**
* 2 rounds of discussion

e819d6f6.title: Principal, Cloud Engineer
e819d6f6.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**
 At
 **ModMed** 
 , we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach:
 **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** 
 This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.
   

  

**A Culture of Excellence**
 When You Join ModMed, You’re Joining An Award\-winning Team Recognized For Innovation And Employee Satisfaction. From Our Global Headquarters In Boca Raton Florida, And Extensive Employee Base In Hyderabad India, We Are a Team Of 4,500\+ Passionate Problem\-solvers On a Mission To Increase Medical Practice Success And Improve Patient Outcomes
   

  

* Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work
* 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* Florida Venture Forum: Venture\-Backed Company of the Year


 We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.
   

  

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**
**Job Description Summary**
**Our Mission \& Vision**
* Our Mission: To place doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty\-specific cloud platform.
* Our Vision: A world where the software ModMed builds increases medical\-practice success and improves patient outcomes.
* Our Core Values: Create customer delight \| Save time \| Innovate boldly, then make things happen \| Align passion with purpose \| Think big \| Have fun \| Do good.


**The Role:** 
 Technical Visionary for Reliability and Developer Velocity As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer at ModMed, you are a primary architect of our technical future. You don't just solve problems; you anticipate the needs of a global healthcare platform years in advance. You will think big to define the standards for reliability, scalability, developer velocity, and security that allow our doctors to provide world\-class care without interruption. This is a high\-impact technical leadership role where you will innovate boldly, then make things happen, acting as a vital bridge between engineering, product, and business goals. By aligning passion with purpose, you will build a resilient infrastructure that serves as the backbone for modern medicine and consistently creates customer delight.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Core Infrastructure Strategy \& Architecture
   

  

* Architectural Strategy \& Technical Governance: Define and execute the long\-term architectural vision for our global AWS cloud ecosystem. Design high\-performance, fault\-tolerant, and cost\-optimized multi\-region topologies capable of scaling elastically to meet massive transaction volumes while enforcing rigorous cloud hygiene (Save time).
* Systemic Observability Ecosystems: Institutionalize "Observability as a Culture" across the enterprise. Architect unified, global telemetry standards using Datadog and OpenTelemetry, transforming raw logs, metrics, and distributed traces into actionable, predictive insights that elevate system reliability across all product engineering groups.
* Developer Platform Evolution \& CI/CD Engineering: Revolutionize the corporate CI/CD philosophy and internal developer platform (IDP) strategy. Engineer systemic, highly automated pipeline improvements using tools like GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, ACK, CUE, and others to eliminate developer friction, optimize resource utilization, and accelerate the release velocity of hundreds of engineers.
* Enterprise Kubernetes Stewardship: Serve as the ultimate authority on container orchestration, microservices deployment, and service mesh architectures. Drive high\-level initiatives to maximize Kubernetes cluster efficiency, auto\-scaling dynamics, secure multi\-tenancy, and immutable deployment patterns across the entire organization.
* Proactive Infrastructure Security \& Compliance: Partner closely with SecOps to architect a zero\-trust infrastructure fortress. Embed automated security guardrails and compliance controls into core Infrastructure\-as\-Code pipelines, ensuring seamless, continuous adherence to strict healthcare regulatory standards, including HIPAA and SOC 2 (Do good).
* Enterprise Triage \& Resilience Engineering: Act as the premier technical escalation authority for critical, cross\-system infrastructure failures. Spearhead complex, multi\-layered root\-cause analysis, lead deep\-dive post\-mortems, and champion engineering patterns that turn production incidents into systemic resilience upgrades.


**Technical Leadership \& Culture Multiplication**
* Engineering Force Multiplier: Act as a strategic force multiplier across the engineering ecosystem. Direct high\-impact cross\-functional initiatives, define and publish enterprise\-wide best practices, influence organizational technology roadmaps, and mentor senior and staff\-level engineers to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture of technical excellence (Have fun. Do good.).


**Role Requirements \& Qualifications Minimum Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with an IT focus.
* Experience: 8\+ years of dedicated experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles.
* Engineering Tenure: 13–15\+ years of distinguished experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Architecture, or DevOps Platform Engineering, with a definitive track record of scaling high\-concurrency, enterprise cloud environments.
* AWS Architectural Authority: Deep, authoritative mastery of the AWS ecosystem (including EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, and advanced networking features) with proven experience executing massive scalability strategies and sophisticated cloud spend optimization structures.
* Advanced Platform Stack: Professional\-grade expertise architecting and managing production\-scale Kubernetes environments, comprehensive Datadog telemetry architectures, and modular Infrastructure\-as\-Code platforms utilizing Terraform or Terragrunt at scale.
* Strategic Engineering \& Tooling: Expert\-level software engineering capability in Python, Go, or Bash to construct intelligent automation engines, internal CLI tools, and infrastructure platforms that systematically eliminate operational toil.
* Executive\-Level Influence: Exceptional communication and advisory skills, with a proven ability to translate complex, low\-level technical trade\-offs into clear strategic visions for executive leadership while remaining capable of conducting a rigorous, line\-by\-line code and architecture review.
* Mission Dedication: A strong desire to apply elite technical expertise toward modernizing healthcare infrastructure, protecting patient data integrity, and solving complex societal\-scale challenges.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's in Engineering or MCA.
* Industry Credentials: Active AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, or relevant advanced Specialty certifications (Security, Advanced Networking).
* Distributed Systems Expertise: Direct experience managing high\-throughput, event\-driven streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis) or high\-scale data warehouse solutions (e.g., Amazon Redshift, Snowflake).
* Community \& Thought Leadership: A history of contributing to foundational open\-source cloud\-native projects, authoring technical white papers, or speaking at premier industry tech conferences (e.g., AWS re:Invent, KubeCon). ModMed Core Behavioral Competencies To thrive in this role, you should naturally embody our foundational competencies:
* Agility: Embraces change as a growth opportunity; learns from successes and failures and adapts to new challenges.
* Results Driven: Consistently achieves quality results, overcomes obstacles, and inspires others to do the same.
* Company Culture: Actively contributes to our culture to keep this company awesome, acts with a values\-first mentality, embraces differences, and creates a sense of belonging for all.
* Customer Focus: Builds strong, positive relationships (internally and externally) and delivers customer\-centric solutions.


***ModMed Benefits Highlight:***
 At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:
   

  

* Meals \& Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches \& dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well\-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work\-life balance,
* Bereavement leave for difficult times and extended medical leave options,
* Paid parental leaves, including maternity, paternity, adoption, surrogacy, and abortion leave,
* Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company\-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.


**PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** 
 ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.
   

  

**ModMed Technologies India Private Limited** 
 follows a strict, merit\-based and transparent recruitment process conducted only through official and authorized channels.
   

  

**We Do Not**
* Charge any fees, processing charges, or amount by any nomenclature, whether as a fee or deposit at any stage of the recruitment process;
* Authorise any individual, employee, or third party to collect any such payments (regardless of nomenclature) to offer or facilitate or recruitment opportunities; or
* Conduct hiring via informal messaging apps or personal email IDs.


 All official communication is made only through verified channels, our website, and recognised recruitment platforms.
   

  

 We strongly advise candidates not to share personal/financial information or make any payments in response to suspicious communications. Any such instances may be reported to us at hrcompliance@modmed.com .
   

  

**ModMed Technologies India Private Limited** 
 will not be responsible for any loss arising from fraudulent or unauthorised communications.

f35c397e.title: Director - Yield Architecture and Engineering
f35c397e.description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited
**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Hardware Engineering
**General Summary:**

We are seeking a strategic, technically credible, and people\-centered leader to serve as Director within the Yield Architecture and Engineering organization in Bangalore. This leader will build a strong, self\-reliant organization focused on Design for Yield, DFT partnership, silicon diagnostics, automation, and corrective and preventive action within those domains, under a clear local leadership and operating model.


The charter for this role is threefold. First, build and lead the Bangalore organization by attracting, retaining, developing, and inspiring exceptional engineering talent, while creating a healthy leadership bench and a durable succession pipeline. Second, establish the operating discipline, governance, and cross\-functional partnerships required to deliver a focused Bangalore charter across Design for Yield, DFT, diagnostics, automation, and domain\-specific CAPA. Third, grow Bangalore into a center of technical capability and innovation that can execute independently, partner globally, and contribute to the future of diagnostics, Design for Yield, automation, and AI\-enabled engineering.


This role requires more than technical management. The successful candidate will be a strong organizational leader who creates clarity, builds trust, develops future leaders, and establishes accountability across a distributed and cross\-functional environment. The Director will work closely with US technical leaders and partner organizations while taking direct responsibility for Bangalore team health, site capability, operating effectiveness, and delivery of the local charter.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 8\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 7\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

**1\. People\-First Organization Leadership**
---------------------------------------------

Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing Bangalore engineering organization with a people\-first mindset. Create a culture of trust, inclusion, accountability, collaboration, and technical excellence. Establish clear expectations, invest in career development, recognize strong performance, address organizational friction, and ensure engineers have the leadership, support, and opportunities needed to succeed.


**2\. Talent, Retention, and Leadership Development**
-----------------------------------------------------

Own the talent system for the Bangalore organization, including hiring, onboarding, retention, capability development, succession planning, and leadership bench strength. Develop technical leaders and future people leaders who can independently own teams, programs, and organizational responsibilities. Create a sustainable organization that does not depend on continuous remote leadership for routine decisions, team development, or operational direction.


**3\. Focused Bangalore Design\-for\-Yield and Diagnostics Charter**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Establish and lead a focused Bangalore charter across Design for Yield, DFT partnership, silicon diagnostics, automation, and corrective and preventive action within those domains. Build an operating model that connects architecture, design, DFT, tapeout readiness, diagnostic readiness, diagnostic support for silicon bring\-up, and continuous improvement. Ensure that responsibilities, interfaces, decision rights, and outcomes are clearly defined across the covered lifecycle.


**4\. Production\-Quality Diagnostics Capability**
--------------------------------------------------

Build and sustain reliable, scalable, production\-quality scan and memory diagnostics capability across Qualcomm's product portfolio. Establish clear ownership for diagnostic readiness, execution, integration, quality, throughput, and continuous improvement. Balance immediate product commitments with the systematic improvements needed to strengthen diagnostic capability and prevent recurring execution gaps.


**5\. Technical Capability Building**
-------------------------------------

Build durable technical depth across diagnostics execution, diagnostics methodology, memory diagnostics, Design for Yield, DFT collaboration, automation, and related engineering disciplines. Identify capability gaps, establish development plans, hire critical expertise, and create mechanisms for knowledge transfer and reuse. Reduce dependence on tribal knowledge by promoting documented methods, reusable workflows, and shared technical standards.


**6\. Design for Yield and Cross\-Lifecycle Feedback**
------------------------------------------------------

Strengthen collaboration with Bangalore Design, DFT, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Failure Analysis, and related engineering teams to move Design for Yield thinking earlier in the product lifecycle. Establish feedback and feedforward mechanisms that convert diagnostic and silicon findings into improved design practices, DFT readiness, diagnostic coverage, defect tolerance, manufacturability, and future product decisions.


**7\. Automation and AI\-Enabled Transformation**
-------------------------------------------------

Champion the thoughtful use of automation, analytics, and AI across Bangalore engineering workflows. Partner with Automation and AI technical leaders to reduce repetitive work, improve engineering productivity, accelerate design and diagnostic analysis, preserve organizational knowledge, and create scalable decision\-support capabilities. Ensure that automation and AI initiatives are tied to measurable engineering needs and integrated into sustainable operating processes.


**8\. Operational Excellence and Governance**
---------------------------------------------

Establish disciplined operating mechanisms across the Bangalore organization, including project plans, technical roadmaps, workforce reviews, operations reviews, metrics, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountable owners. Create transparent visibility into commitments, risks, dependencies, staffing, and capability gaps. Promote proactive planning and continuous improvement rather than recurring firefighting.


**9\. Cross\-Functional and Global Partnership**
------------------------------------------------

Build strong working relationships across Bangalore Design and DFT organizations and with global YAE, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Failure Analysis, Automation, AI, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders. Clarify organizational interfaces, resolve cross\-functional barriers, and drive shared outcomes in Design for Yield, DFT, diagnostics, automation, and related CAPA through technical credibility, clear communication, and collaborative problem solving.


**10\. Site Capability and Organizational Stewardship**
-------------------------------------------------------

Serve as a visible leadership presence for the Bangalore organization. Take responsibility for team health, organizational stability, employee engagement, leadership effectiveness, and the long\-term growth of the site's capability. Represent Bangalore needs and opportunities in global planning while ensuring alignment with broader YAE and PPS priorities.


**11\. Strategic Planning and Resource Management**
---------------------------------------------------

Translate organizational priorities into a practical capability roadmap and staffing plan. Assess the required skills, current bench, critical gaps, and hiring sequence. Allocate resources according to business priority, technical risk, and team capacity while protecting mission\-critical delivery and investing in long\-term capability.


**12\. Innovation in Ambiguous Problem Spaces**
-----------------------------------------------

Lead effectively where the technical path, ownership model, or organizational boundaries are not yet fully defined. Bring structure to complex problems, develop options and tradeoffs, establish accountable ownership, and guide teams toward scalable solutions that support Qualcomm's emerging technologies and future business needs.


**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or a related field and 8\+ years of ASIC design, DFT, silicon diagnostics, product engineering, test engineering, Design for Yield, validation, integration, or related work experience.

**OR**

* Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or a related field and 7\+ years of ASIC design, DFT, silicon diagnostics, product engineering, test engineering, Design for Yield, validation, integration, or related work experience.

**OR**

* PhD in Science, Engineering, or a related field and 6\+ years of ASIC design, DFT, silicon diagnostics, product engineering, test engineering, Design for Yield, validation, integration, or related work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

**1\. Education**
-----------------

Bachelor's or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.


**2\. Semiconductor Engineering Experience**
--------------------------------------------

12\+ years of experience in semiconductor engineering, including experience in one or more of the following areas: Design for Yield, DFT, ATPG diagnostics, memory diagnostics, product engineering, test engineering, silicon diagnostics, failure analysis, or post\-silicon engineering.


**3\. Engineering Leadership Experience**
-----------------------------------------

5\+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical organizations, or major cross\-functional programs, with demonstrated success building capability and delivering results across functions or sites.


**4\. People Leadership Excellence**
------------------------------------

Demonstrated ability to lead with empathy, clarity, consistency, and accountability. Strong record of hiring and retaining talent, developing engineers, coaching managers and technical leaders, creating succession pipelines, and building a healthy culture in a high\-performance engineering environment.


**5\. Organization Building**
-----------------------------

Experience building or transforming an engineering team, site capability, or technical function. Demonstrated ability to establish a charter, define roles, build a leadership bench, close capability gaps, and create an organization that can operate with increasing independence.


**6\. Semiconductor Systems Perspective**
-----------------------------------------

Strong understanding of the semiconductor product lifecycle and the interactions among architecture, design, DFT, test, diagnostics, product engineering, failure analysis, manufacturing, and diagnostic/design feedback loops. Ability to connect diagnostic and Design for Yield feedback to operating accountability across these boundaries.


**7\. Diagnostics and Design\-for\-Yield Credibility**
------------------------------------------------------

Technical knowledge of silicon diagnostics, diagnostic readiness, Design for Yield, DFT, production\-quality diagnostic execution, or related post\-silicon disciplines. Ability to engage credibly with technical experts, evaluate engineering risks, and guide priorities without becoming a bottleneck for detailed execution.


**8\. Operational Leadership and Governance**
---------------------------------------------

Demonstrated success establishing operating mechanisms such as project plans, roadmaps, technical reviews, workforce reviews, metrics, decision frameworks, risk management, escalation paths, and continuous improvement practices.


**9\. Cross\-Functional Influence**
-----------------------------------

Proven ability to align teams with different priorities, responsibilities, and technical perspectives. Ability to influence decisions through credibility, structured communication, evidence, and collaborative problem solving.


**10\. Automation and AI Orientation**
--------------------------------------

Experience sponsoring, adopting, or scaling automation, analytics, software, or AI\-enabled engineering workflows. Ability to identify where technology can improve productivity, quality, knowledge retention, or technical decision\-making while partnering effectively with specialized Automation and AI teams.


**11\. Strategic and Systems Thinking**
---------------------------------------

Ability to translate broad organizational objectives into an executable charter, capability roadmap, staffing plan, operating model, and measurable outcomes. Demonstrated ability to balance immediate product delivery with longer\-term capability investment.


**12\. Leadership Under Ambiguity**
-----------------------------------

Demonstrated ability to create structure and direction when the technical solution, ownership boundaries, or organizational model are not fully defined. Comfortable leading complex initiatives that require experimentation, judgment, and coordination across multiple organizations.


**13\. Global Leadership and Communication**
--------------------------------------------

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience leading across geographic, functional, and cultural boundaries. Ability to represent the Bangalore organization effectively with technical leaders, partner organizations, and senior management.


**14\. Community Builder**
--------------------------

Demonstrated ability to create stability, trust, shared purpose, and deep collaboration across complex or evolving team environments.

* **Stakeholder ownership:** Carry architecture and security posture through client technology and security review; act as final technical escalation on deployment and production issues.
* **Selective hands\-on:** Prototype high\-risk components, resolve critical\-path blockers, and review production code — sufficient depth to make credible decisions, without becoming the delivery bottleneck.

* 10\+ years in software, platform or applied AI engineering, including 4\+ years leading engineering teams on systems that reached production.
* Full\-stack delivery background — Python, relational and NoSQL stores, web application deployment, CI/CD and DevOps practice.
* Hands\-on architecture experience with the standing to own and defend decisions with client cloud and security teams.

**Success Measures**
====================

* Solutions reach production on committed timelines, with architecture and security accepted with minimal remediation.

We are seeking a Lead Architect to define the target architecture for an enterprise\-grade procurement agentic AI solution. The Lead Architect will work closely with client technology stakeholders, the Solution Lead, AI/ML teams, data engineers, security teams and delivery leadership to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, operable and fit for enterprise deployment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end\-to\-end target architecture across data, AI/ML, GenAI, agent orchestration, APIs, integration, observability, security and user\-facing application layers.
* Assess client constraints and determine the appropriate Azure deployment stack, including services for compute, storage, data processing, model serving, GenAI, integration, secrets, networking, monitoring and CI/CD.
* Define cloud deployment patterns across Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks or equivalent data platforms, AKS, Container Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus or Event Grid, Key Vault, Monitor and related services as appropriate.
* Advise on when to use agents, conventional services, rules engines, workflow orchestration, ML models, optimization services and event\-driven automation rather than forcing all use cases into an agent pattern.
* Translate business workflows into executable solution flows spanning sensing, signal processing, forecasting, recommendation, approval, action and traceability layers.
* Define API and integration architecture for interaction with enterprise source systems, planning tools, data platforms, UI applications, model endpoints and external services.
* Establish non\-functional requirements and architecture guardrails for scalability, latency, resilience, disaster recovery, cost efficiency, explainability, auditability and supportability.
* Define identity and access patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, data protection controls, content safety, prompt security and responsible AI controls in collaboration with client security teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical decision records and trade\-off discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide hands\-on guidance to engineering teams on implementation patterns, reusable components, deployment standards and technical issue resolution.
* Own architecture alignment across environments including development, test, UAT, and production, with clear promotion, rollback and release patterns.
* Guide observability design across application traces, agent traces, prompt and tool execution, model performance, API metrics, data pipeline health, cost usage and business process outcomes.
* Support capacity planning and cloud cost optimization, including workload sizing, token consumption controls, autoscaling, caching, batching and appropriate service selection.
* Collaborate with the Lead Manager and Solution Lead to balance delivery timelines with architecture quality and enterprise readiness.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution architecture, cloud architecture, platform engineering or related technology leadership roles.
* Strong hands\-on architecture experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise deployment patterns.
* Proven experience designing distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, containerized workloads and cloud\-native integrations.
* Strong understanding of GenAI and agentic AI architecture, including LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, state and memory patterns, evaluation, guardrails and human approval mechanisms.
* Ability to design architectures that combine conventional software services, AI/ML models, optimization engines, data pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Strong knowledge of security, identity, networking, observability, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code and production operations in enterprise environments.
* Experience engaging with client architects, CIO/CTO organizations, cloud platform teams, security stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Strong ability to communicate architecture trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders and drive decisions under real\-world constraints.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, AKS, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault, Entra ID and Azure Monitor.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent patterns and frameworks.
* Exposure to supply chain, demand forecasting, planning, semiconductor or high\-tech industry solutions.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, prompt and agent evaluation and production AI governance.
* Relevant Azure architecture certifications or equivalent demonstrable experience.

**Key Deliverables**

* Target\-state solution architecture and Azure service deployment blueprint.
* Agent architecture and orchestration design, including tool boundaries and control flows.
* End\-to\-end sequence flows for key business scenarios and exception paths.
* Integration, API, identity, networking, security, observability and environment architecture.
* Architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, deployment standards and engineering guardrails.
* Production\-readiness and scalability recommendations, including cost and operational considerations.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Architecture is accepted by client technology and security stakeholders with minimal late\-stage redesign.
* Solution is deployable, scalable, secure, observable and supportable across enterprise environments.
* Agent and orchestration patterns remain controlled, explainable and appropriate to the business workflow.

* Engineering teams can implement consistently using clear architecture standards and reusable patterns.

The company values a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, fostering an environment where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to transformative projects that make a real difference in the world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Associate Architect \- Java at Quantiphi is a critical technical leadership role responsible for designing, developing, and modernizing enterprise Java applications. The ideal candidate will serve as a bridge between client requirements and technical execution, ensuring high\-quality delivery of software solutions that align with business objectives. This position involves engaging with clients for project briefings, providing consultation on technical strategies, and overseeing the implementation of robust, scalable, and secure applications. The Associate Architect will also mentor team members, promote best practices in coding and architecture, and stay updated with the latest industry trends to continuously enhance service standards. The role offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects within a collaborative environment, contributing to the technological advancement of client organizations and the growth of Quantiphi itself.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate should possess a strong educational background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields, with 7\-12 years of professional experience in software development and architecture. Demonstrable expertise in Java application modernization, including upgrading legacy systems to newer Java LTS versions (Java 17/21/25\), is essential. Candidates must have hands\-on experience in developing enterprise\-level web applications using J2EE and Spring Boot frameworks, along with proficiency in API integration, cloud architecture, and application security. Familiarity with tools such as Git, Maven, and JFrog is required. A solid understanding of object\-oriented programming principles, unit and integration testing, and Agile methodologies is necessary. Experience working with REST and SOAP APIs, Microservices architecture, and both SQL and NoSQL databases will be highly valued. Knowledge of AWS services, cloud deployment, and automation tools like AWS Transform Custom (ATX) adds significant advantage. Strong problem\-solving skills, excellent communication, and the ability to work collaboratively within distributed teams are essential for success in this role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Associate Architect will be responsible for leading technical aspects of client projects, including initial project briefing, solution design, and implementation oversight. They will support the development, enhancement, and modernization of enterprise Java applications, ensuring adherence to best practices and industry standards. The role involves managing client expectations, negotiating technical requirements, and creating comprehensive technical documentation. Supervising workflows between internal teams and external resources, the Associate Architect will facilitate smooth project execution and timely delivery. They will evaluate project data for accuracy, set project milestones, and prioritize tasks to meet client and organizational goals. Providing mentorship and training to team members is a key aspect, fostering skill development and technical excellence. The candidate will actively research emerging technologies and trends to incorporate innovative solutions into projects. Ensuring APIs are robust, maintainable, and scalable is critical, along with coordinating across different layers of infrastructure. Additional responsibilities include troubleshooting, performance optimization, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the team.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Quantiphi offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well\-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, performance\-based incentives, and flexible work arrangements to promote work\-life balance. Employees have access to extensive learning and development programs, including certifications, workshops, and industry conferences, to stay ahead in their field. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment, encouraging innovation and open communication. Health benefits such as medical insurance, dental coverage, and wellness programs are provided to ensure overall health and safety. Additionally, Quantiphi promotes a culture of recognition and rewards, with opportunities for career advancement within a rapidly growing organization. Employees also benefit from a vibrant community, engaging in various team\-building activities and corporate social responsibility initiatives, making it a fulfilling place to build a long\-term career.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diversity enriches our culture and enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join our team and contribute to our mission of delivering transformative technology solutions.

689aa5a2.title: Oracle APEX & Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect
689aa5a2.description:
**About The Company**

We are calling candidates on behalf of a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, It provides comprehensive range of solutions in the area of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over a decade in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across industry verticals.

**Job Title: Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect**

**Location: Bangalore (Work from Office / Hybrid as applicable)**

**Experience: 10\+ Years**

**Engagement Type: Long\-term / Multi\-year (Contract / Full\-time)**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and delivery of a custom Agent Billing platform as part of Project Fusion. The solution will support the calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing of monthly agent charges that are not supported natively within Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

The successful candidate will architect and build a scalable Oracle PaaS\-based application using Oracle APEX, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Fusion REST APIs, and Oracle Database technologies. The platform will operate as a billing orchestration and calculation engine tightly integrated with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.

The role requires strong hands\-on Oracle architecture and development expertise, with the ability to translate complex business billing requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions and provide technical leadership from requirements through production implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Solution Architecture \& Business Analysis

* Work with business stakeholders, finance teams, product owners, and Oracle functional teams to understand agent billing processes, business rules, exceptions, approvals, reconciliation requirements, and invoicing scenarios.
* Translate business requirements into end\-to\-end solution architecture, application components, data models, integration flows, security controls, and implementation roadmaps.
* Design the Agent Billing platform as an extension to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP capabilities without unnecessarily duplicating native Fusion functionality.
* Define functional and technical boundaries between Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, OIC, and supporting PaaS services.
* Design scalable architecture capable of supporting monthly billing cycles, high transaction volumes, auditability, traceability, and future business expansion.

**Oracle APEX \& Application Development**

* Design and develop enterprise\-grade applications using Oracle APEX, including user interfaces, interactive reports, dashboards, forms, workflows, validations, and role\-based functionality.
* Build robust calculation and billing orchestration logic for monthly agent charges, including configurable business rules, adjustments, exceptions, approvals, and reconciliation.
* Design reusable APEX components and application patterns following Oracle development and enterprise architecture standards.
* Implement application\-level audit trails, status tracking, exception management, and operational reporting.
* Optimize APEX applications for performance, usability, maintainability, and secure enterprise deployment.

**Oracle Fusion Cloud Integration \& OIC**

* Architect and implement integrations between Oracle APEX and Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, and other appropriate Oracle integration mechanisms.
* Integrate with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.
* Design reliable integration patterns for data synchronization, transaction creation/update, status retrieval, error handling, retries, reconciliation, and monitoring.
* Develop and maintain OIC integrations, mappings, transformations, orchestration flows, and exception\-handling mechanisms.
* Ensure integration designs are loosely coupled, secure, scalable, observable, and aligned with Oracle Fusion Cloud integration standards.

**Billing, Reconciliation \& Financial Processing**

* Architect the end\-to\-end lifecycle for agent charge calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing.
* Design calculation engines and configurable rules to accommodate complex monthly agent billing scenarios not natively supported by Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Design reconciliation processes between the custom billing platform and Oracle Fusion financial transactions.
* Support integration with AR invoicing, AP processing, customer and supplier master data, project\-related transactions, and AP/AR Netting.
* Ensure financial data integrity, transaction traceability, controls, and auditability across the billing lifecycle.

**Database \& Data Architecture**

* Design Oracle Database schemas, data models, tables, views, stored procedures, packages, functions, sequences, indexes, and data access patterns supporting the platform.
* Develop efficient SQL and PL/SQL for billing calculations, data processing, validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Define data retention, audit, archival, performance, and data\-quality strategies.
* Optimize database performance and ensure appropriate transaction management and concurrency controls.

**Security, Performance \& Production Readiness**

* Design application and integration security including authentication, authorization, role\-based access, API security, secrets management, and least\-privilege principles.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and access controls for billing preparation, review, approval, reconciliation, and financial processing.
* Define performance, scalability, availability, logging, monitoring, and operational support requirements.
* Lead technical reviews, architecture governance, code reviews, deployment readiness, and production support transition.
* Identify technical risks, integration dependencies, performance bottlenecks, and architectural constraints and drive mitigation plans.

**Delivery \& Technical Leadership**

* Lead the solution through architecture, development, testing, deployment, and stabilization phases.
* Work closely with Oracle functional consultants, developers, QA, integration teams, business stakeholders, and customer IT teams.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to APEX, OIC, database, and integration developers.
* Create architecture documents, interface specifications, data models, technical design documents, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Promote reusable integration, APEX, database, and Oracle Fusion solution patterns and engineering best practices.

**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Stay current with Oracle APEX, Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle Database, REST APIs, and Oracle PaaS capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce manual reconciliation, and increase billing accuracy.
* Contribute to reusable Oracle accelerators, reference architectures, development standards, and technical best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in Oracle application development, solution architecture, enterprise application integration, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle APEX application development and enterprise solution architecture.
* Proven experience designing and implementing Oracle Fusion Cloud integrations, preferably across Financials modules.
* Strong experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, Oracle Database, SQL, and PL/SQL.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and translating complex financial/business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience leading technical teams and delivering enterprise applications in production environments.

**Technical Skills**

Oracle APEX \& Database

* Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, database design, stored procedures, packages, functions, views, triggers, indexing, performance tuning, and data modeling.

**Oracle Fusion Cloud**

* Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Financials, Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting; understanding of Fusion business processes and REST APIs.

**Integration \& APIs**

* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, JSON/XML, API orchestration, mappings, transformations, error handling, retries, monitoring, and integration security.

**Application Architecture**

* Oracle PaaS architecture, enterprise application architecture, workflow/orchestration, scalable application design, role\-based security, auditability, observability, and production operations.

**Delivery \& Engineering**

* Agile delivery, SDLC, requirements analysis, technical design, code reviews, testing strategy, CI/CD and deployment practices, technical documentation, and production support.

**Core Competencies**

* Oracle APEX Solution Architecture
* Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Integration
* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* Billing \& Financial Process Architecture
* Oracle Database \& PL/SQL Development
* REST API \& Enterprise Integration
* Business Requirements Analysis
* Application \& Data Architecture
* Security, Performance \& Scalability
* Technical Leadership \& Mentoring
* Stakeholder Management
* Technical Design \& Documentation
* Problem Solving \& Root\-Cause Analysis
* Production Delivery \& Operational Excellence

**Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of a scalable Agent Billing platform supporting calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing processes.
* Reliable and secure integration between the custom billing platform and Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Accurate and auditable billing calculations and reconciliation with Oracle Fusion AR, AP, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.
* High\-quality Oracle APEX applications and OIC integrations meeting functional, performance, security, and maintainability standards.
* Successful production implementation with minimal operational disruption and effective support transition.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction and effective collaboration across business, functional, technical, and delivery teams.
* Contribution to reusable Oracle architecture patterns, accelerators, development standards, and organizational capability development.

**Associate Architect \- Java Job DescriptionAbout The Company**
 Quantiphi is a leading AI and data science company dedicated to transforming businesses through innovative technology solutions. With a focus on leveraging artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics, Quantiphi helps organizations achieve operational excellence, enhance customer experiences, and drive digital transformation. Our commitment to excellence and innovation has positioned us as a trusted partner for Fortune 500 companies and startups alike. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages continuous learning and growth, empowering our employees to deliver impactful solutions that make a difference.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Associate Architect specializing in Java to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in bridging technical expertise with strategic project management, ensuring the successful delivery of enterprise\-level Java applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in modernizing legacy systems, developing robust APIs, and implementing cloud\-native solutions. As an Associate Architect, you will collaborate closely with clients to understand their needs, translate requirements into scalable technical solutions, and lead the development teams to achieve project goals. Your expertise will be instrumental in designing, enhancing, and maintaining high\-quality software architectures aligned with industry best practices. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects in a fast\-paced environment, contributing to innovative digital transformation initiatives across diverse industries.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate should possess a comprehensive technical background with a minimum of 7 years of experience in Java application development and architecture. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields is required; a master's degree is preferred. Proven experience in enterprise application modernization, especially upgrading legacy systems to Java 17/21/25, is highly desirable. Candidates should have extensive hands\-on experience with J2EE, Spring Boot, REST and SOAP APIs, Microservices architecture, and cloud platforms such as AWS. Proficiency in tools like Git, Maven, and JFrog is essential. Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming principles, database management (SQL/NoSQL), and application security is expected. The candidate should demonstrate familiarity with Agile methodologies, unit and integration testing, and automated code modernization tools like AWS Transform Custom (ATX). Excellent problem\-solving skills, effective communication, and the ability to lead technical teams are critical for success in this role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Associate Architect will be responsible for engaging with clients for project briefing, consultation, installation, and project close\-out reviews. You will support the design, development, enhancement, and modernization of enterprise Java applications, ensuring high standards of quality and performance. Managing customer demands and expectations will be key to maintaining client satisfaction while aligning deliverables with project scope and timelines. You will negotiate project requirements and specifications, assisting in creating detailed technical documentation. Supervising activities between internal teams and external resources to ensure seamless workflow and timely delivery is essential. You will evaluate project data for accuracy, set project targets, and prioritize tasks effectively. Mentoring and training team members to enhance their technical skills and knowledge is part of your leadership responsibilities. Staying updated with current industry practices and emerging technologies will help improve service standards and delivery. You will review customer technical requirements, assist in identifying optimal solutions for system integration, and ensure the robustness and maintainability of APIs and architectures. Conducting research on new trends, tools, and methodologies to incorporate innovative solutions into projects will be a continuous part of your role. Additionally, you will perform other technical duties as required, ensuring adherence to best coding practices and architectural standards across the development lifecycle.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Quantiphi offers a competitive salary package complemented by comprehensive benefits including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Employees have access to ongoing learning and development opportunities, including certifications, training programs, and participation in industry conferences. The company promotes a flexible work environment with options for remote work, fostering a healthy work\-life balance. Additional perks include performance\-based incentives, recognition programs, and a collaborative culture that values innovation and diversity. We also provide wellness programs and support initiatives aimed at employee well\-being, ensuring a motivating and engaging workplace for all team members.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Quantiphi is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, experience, and the ability to contribute to our mission of delivering innovative technology solutions. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances creativity and drives better business outcomes, and we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

**Description**
 We are looking for a Deployment Architect to lead customer deployments for Velocity Operations within the Infor Velocity Suite. In this role, you will own the architectural approach for deploying Velocity capabilities into customer environments, ensuring each rollout is secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise operational needs. You will define deployment standards, reference architectures, environment strategy, governance guardrails, and operational readiness criteria that enable consistent execution across customers. The role requires strong leadership in evaluating deployment risks, establishing non\-functional requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring solutions are ready for adoption, sustainment, and long\-term value realization. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in deployment architecture, customer\-facing engagement, and enterprise platform readiness, with a practical understanding of Infor OS, CloudSuite, and the operational considerations required to successfully run Velocity solutions at scale.
   

  

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
* Own the deployment architecture for Velocity Operations engagements, defining the target architecture and deployment approach for customer environments.
* Establish reference architectures, deployment standards, and environment design principles to ensure repeatable, scalable, and supportable rollouts across customers.
* Define non\-functional architecture requirements covering security, reliability, observability, scalability, resiliency, and operational supportability.
* Architect end\-to\-end deployment patterns across Infor CloudSuite, Infor OS, APIs, data flows, and third\-party systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise constraints and operational objectives.
* Lead architecture reviews for environment readiness, integration readiness, migration readiness, and production cutover, ensuring solutions are fit for go\-live and sustainment.
* Evaluate deployment risks, identify architectural gaps, and define mitigation strategies to improve rollout success and long\-term platform stability.
* Provide architecture governance for key technical decisions, design exceptions, scope boundaries, and operational guardrails throughout the deployment lifecycle.
* Partner with product, engineering, delivery, and support teams to align deployment architecture with product capabilities, implementation realities, and operational best practices.
* Promote reusable deployment patterns, automation assets, and standardized operating models that accelerate adoption and improve consistency across Velocity deployments.
* Create and maintain architecture artifacts, deployment blueprints, decision records, readiness criteria, and customer\-facing technical guidance to support successful execution at scale.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise software deployment architecture, solution architecture, platform engineering, or customer\-facing technical consulting, with strong ownership of production rollout readiness.
* Strong understanding of Infor OS, Infor CloudSuite deployment models, integration architecture, APIs, event\-driven patterns, and enterprise platform dependencies.
* Proven experience defining reference architectures, deployment standards, environment strategies, and governance guardrails for repeatable and scalable customer rollouts.
* Deep knowledge of non\-functional architecture requirements, including security, scalability, resiliency, observability, reliability, and operational supportability.
* Experience evaluating deployment risks, assessing platform and environment readiness, and guiding architecture decisions through migration, testing, cutover, and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, integration frameworks, data flows, troubleshooting distributed systems, and resolving deployment and production readiness issues.
* Experience with process automation and operational improvement technologies such as RPA, process mining, GenAI\-enabled workflows, or related transformation solutions is preferred.
* Working knowledge of architecture documentation, decision records, delivery governance, and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence/Wiki.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and workshop facilitation skills, with the ability to engage customer, delivery, product, engineering, and leadership teams on architecture direction and deployment readiness.

* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards while leading code reviews during projects to ensure quality, using tools like GitHub Copilot and AI coding assistants to enforce design patterns, optimize performance, and accelerate the delivery of custom code, integrations, and data migrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 14\+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 8 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and familiarity with Agentforce
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire


**Preferred Certifications**
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect
* Other relevant AI/ML, AI Specialist, or Cloud Architect certifications


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
